raw.description:
Our team at Blackline Safety is growing! As a people-driven technology company, with a mission to make sure every worker returns home safely, we drive innovation, practice resiliency, demonstrate leadership, go the extra mile for our customers, and empower our people to be their best.

Reporting to the Vice President, Client Success, the Manager, Client Success plays a key role in driving client goals, product utilization, retention efforts of our clients, and the oversight of our Client Success Managers. This role will lead the day-to-day operations of a Client Success team of 5-8 Client Success Managers and drive the strategic initiatives to support the overall goals of the department and the organization. This role will require daily support not only for clients but also cross-functionally with all internal teams within the organization to ensure continued growth within existing clients and future clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Working in collaboration with the Vice President, Client Success, building leading, and mentoring the Client Success team, by ensuring the team remains objective and results driven.
  • Oversee the retention of our customer base with the continuous coaching of our Client Success Managers
  • Oversee the renewal of customers’ service contracts through the oversite of renewal quotes and ensure our Client Success team follows through to completion.
  • Oversee the application of sales methodologies to create, manage and close opportunities for account expansion to increase revenue from existing accounts
  • Identify areas of development within the Client Success Managers and ensure that the team remains world-class.
  • Coach and mentor Client Success Managers to ensure the successful development of strategic customer account plans.
  • Ensure Client Success Managers maintain currency in Blackline Safety products and become product experts in all Blackline products and services.
  • Work with the Client Success Managers to escalate internal and external concerns, by ensuring that all resources used maintain customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure that Client Success Managers are providing feedback to product management teams on long-term trends that may affect customer satisfaction or retention.
  • Report on KPIs to Management
  • Monitor work schedules for the team to ensure they meet deployment demands both locally and internationally, recommending adjustments as required.
  • Aid in documenting procedures, establish training
  • Actively looks for ways to improve process efficiencies and effectiveness
  • Other duties as assigned.

About You

  • Post-Secondary education or equivalent certification in a business-related field is an asset
  • Minimum 2 years' leading a customer-facing customer support team
  • Proven track record of leading and energizing a group to be successful and meet targets
  • Ability to drive results in an ever-changing environment
  • Ability to identify meaningful metrics for reporting and analysis of operational issues
  • Clear communication, both written and verbal with strong interpersonal skills

Total Rewards

At Blackline Safety, we offer more than just a job—we offer a career with purpose. Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to support the diverse needs of our global workforce and vary based on employment type and location. They may include:

  • Competitive base salary and annual compensation review
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits*
  • Mental health and wellness support
  • Flexible work arrangements and hybrid work model for eligible positions
  • Paid vacation, personal and sick days*
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Education funding
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and mission-driven culture
  • Exclusive access to perks and discounts
  • A flexible ‘Dress for Your Day’ environment

*Eligibility and coverage vary by employment type and region.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Blackline Safety is powered by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants, regardless of age, religion, race, color, ancestry, gender, gender identity or expression, disability, national origin, race, or sexual orientation. We enthusiastically encourage all individuals to apply for positions that fit their passions.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us at . We are committed to ensuring an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates.

Join Us

If you’re passionate about technology, safety, and making a difference, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help us build a safer, more connected world.

Unauthorized Recruitment Communication Alert

We are aware of the instances in which individuals are receiving fraudulent job offers or interview requests that are fraudulently alleged to be from Blackline Safety.

Blackline Safety does not request payment or personal financial information at any stage of the recruitment process.

Please exercise caution, and do not respond to emails or other communications that are not from a Blackline Safety email address.

TITLE: Senior Fullstack Developer (React/Node.js/Java Spring Boot) - Full Remote Portugal﻿

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer to join a well-established, engineering-driven software consultancy known for its collaborative, politics-free culture built on lean principles and self-organisation. This is an opportunity to work alongside a highly skilled, autonomous team that values craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous learning over rigid hierarchy. You'll help build fluid, responsive user interfaces and resilient backend services for multiple platforms, solving complex technical problems to world-class standards. Occasional travel (0-15% of your time) may be required depending on the project and client needs.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

You'll be embedded in a team responsible for the full software delivery lifecycle — from local development through to production — working on asynchronous, event-driven workflows and modern cloud-native services. The role spans both frontend and backend, requiring strong fundamentals across the stack, a testing-first mindset, and curiosity about containerization and modern DevOps practices. You'll work within agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, security, and resilience.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (Required)

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js
  • Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot
  • Experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and CDK/Serverless
  • Solid knowledge of HTTP, REST, and/or GraphQL architectural patterns
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Familiarity with service-oriented architectures, design patterns, and data structures
  • Working knowledge of Git in a continuous delivery process
  • Experience writing semantic, accessible HTML
  • Comfortable using code quality tools (linters, type checkers, static analysers)
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Fluent in English (required)

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred)

  • Exposure to containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience mentoring or supporting less senior engineers
  • Prior experience in a consultancy or client-facing engineering environment

﻿Compensation: €2,300 – €2,900/month net, depending on experience and seniority level.

raw.description:
SKEELO: EMBARQUE NA JORNADA QUE COLOCA A LEITURA NO CENTRO DE TUDO. 🐿️

QUEM SOMOS 💚

O Skeelo é uma plataforma digital de leitura que conecta pessoas a e-books, audiobooks e minibooks em uma experiência acessível e personalizada. Desde 2019, usamos a tecnologia como um meio para democratizar o acesso à leitura e ampliar seu impacto no desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Acreditamos que ler vai além do lazer: é uma ferramenta poderosa para expandir repertórios, fortalecer o pensamento crítico e impulsionar o desenvolvimento humano.

NOSSA VIBE 💚

Estamos distribuídos e distribuídas pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, movidos por inovação, agilidade e aprendizado contínuo, que valoriza a diversidade e transforma a leitura para se adaptar à vida das pessoas. Fazemos tudo isso com transparência nas relações, coragem para inovar, foco em alta performance, olhar constante para encantar clientes e leitores e entregas ágeis que fazem a diferença.

Nosso modelo de trabalho é remote first, tirando o melhor do home office: autorresponsabilidade com autonomia. Porém também acreditamos na conexão e trocas dos encontros presenciais, desse modo, temos alguns encontros presenciais em São Paulo - SP, para conexão com os demais Skeelers. Mas relaxa, o Skeelo sempre organiza tudo pra gente.

O time de Relações Institucionais está precisando de alguém, e queremos você com a gente!
Sua missão? Liderar a estratégia global de Relações Públicas da Skeelo, construindo e protegendo a reputação da marca em mercados do Brasil à Europa — sendo o principal guardião da narrativa externa da empresa.

O seu dia a dia no Skeelo vai ser assim:

  • Definir e executar a estratégia global de PR, coordenando agências locais no Brasil, LATAM e Europa (Espanha, Itália, Alemanha e Reino Unido)
  • Gerenciar crises institucionais e de reputação, desenvolvendo o playbook de crise e treinando lideranças para resposta rápida e adequada
  • Construir e consolidar o "colchão reputacional" da Skeelo por meio de relações com a mídia, produção de conteúdo editorial e presença estratégica em eventos
  • Coordenar a comunicação da agenda ESG da empresa, traduzindo iniciativas de impacto social em narrativas relevantes para investidores e stakeholders globais
  • Apoiar o posicionamento do Board e das lideranças de país em comunicações institucionais, entrevistas e aparições públicas

Para isso, você vai precisar ter:

  • Experiência sólida em Relações Públicas, comunicação corporativa ou Corporate Affairs, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia ou com operação internacional
  • Capacidade de desenvolver narrativas globais adaptadas a contextos culturais e regulatórios distintos
  • Experiência em gestão de crises de reputação e relacionamento com veículos de mídia de alto nível
  • Domínio do inglês (espanhol será um diferencial importante dado o escopo LATAM e Europa)
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em estruturas matriciais e influenciar sem autoridade direta

E seria muito bom se você também tivesse:

  • Vivência ou profundo conhecimento dos mercados europeus, especialmente Reino Unido, Alemanha, Espanha ou Itália
  • Experiência com comunicação de agenda ESG e relatórios de sustentabilidade
  • Background em empresas do setor de tecnologia, mídia, educação ou mercado editorial

E os benefícios? A gente cuida bem de quem constrói isso aqui 💚

  • Plano de saúde (sem custo e sem coparticipação para você e seus familiares) + odonto e seguro de vida
  • VA/VR flexível no Caju (liberdade real de uso)
  • Bem-estar completo: Totalpass (atividade física) + ZenKlub (saúde mental)
  • PPR anual atrelado a metas e impacto
  • Acesso ao Skeelo Premium + clube do livro com ebook do mês
  • Auxílio creche + licença parental estendida
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas, Berlitz e Open English
  • Feriados de SP emendados + recesso remunerado no fim do ano
  • Day off de aniversário

Quer ver tudo com mais detalhes? Dá uma olhada na nossa página de carreiras:

DEU MATCH? ENTÃO VEM CÁ! 💚

Se você busca desenvolvimento e quer gerar impacto facilitando o acesso à leitura, vem construir sua carreira com a gente. Esse papel principal pode ser seu, está esperando o que para se inscrever? #ValeAPenaSerSkeeler

Senior Recruitment Consultant Doctors Division

MedicsPro Limited is one of the UKs leading specialist healthcare recruitment agencies, contracted to supply medical staff to a wide range of public and private sector clients throughout the UK. Our people are industry experts, providing staffing for roles such as doctors, nurses, allied health professionals (AHP) and health science staff (HSS).

We are looking for a Senior Recruitment Consultant to join our Doctors (various specialties) Team. As a Senior Recruitment Consultant, you are the vital link between clients and candidates; a mentor to team members within the business to support and develop to become ambassadors of MedicsPro and a driving force of organisational strategy.

The Senior Recruitment Consultant (Doctors) vacancy is a great developmental opportunity for an established recruitment consultant who is looking for career growth. To gain further client engagement and a step up into a leadership role. With your proven track record of recruitment, lead generation and good client relationship this progression role is a credible career option.

The role is exciting, fast paced, and challenging, which is target driven and rewarding. We have excellent training programmes to enable our team members to thrive and succeed. If you are an experienced recruiter with Temporary or Permanent recruitment experience, we would like for you to be part of the strategy to push an existing division forward.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Sourcing, interviewing, and recruiting candidates for placement with NHS and Private Healthcare providers.
  • Building strong relationships with candidates ensuring collaborative working to enable prompt bookings.
  • Providing the highest level of customer service and deliver quality candidate experience.
  • Coaching and guiding team members to become high performers.
  • Taking ownership and responsibility for client related issues and queries.
  • Establishing partnership working with key stakeholders to ensure provision of staffing to fill vacancies.
  • Developing relationships with internal stakeholders and support functions (Compliance, IT, Accounts, Payroll, Business Development).
  • Maintaining own pool of locums/workers conducting regular communication and continually improve your knowledge on their roles and vocations.
  • Networking and to build business information and leads that can be converted into commercial opportunities.

Key Attributes

  • Proven sales background.
  • Demonstrate experience as a recruiter, minimum 1 year.
  • Evidenced knowledge of talent pipeline management and growth.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and targets (Goal-Orientated).
  • Ambitious with a tenacity to succeed.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Sales and negotiating skills.
  • Teamworking and mentoring skills.
  • IT proficient MS Office and CRM database.

At MedicsPro we are continually exploring and adopting new innovative methods in our approach to this very niche and diverse marketplace, aiming to cater to all our clients needs and create a bespoke recruitment service.

Our business is in a continual growth strategy and now is a pinnacle time to join our critical service provision.

We look forward to receiving your application.

raw.description:
– This employment opportunity is through Delfina Medical Group –

Objective: Delfina Medical Group is hiring a full-time, Spanish and English based bilingual Registered Dietitian and Lactation Consultant to support patients through pregnancy and postpartum. This is a 100% virtual position. The role combines direct patient care with building and maintaining clinical protocols, and grows over time to include additional state licensure and support for other dietitians as the team expands.

About Us: Delfina Medical Group and Delfina Care Inc. provide a leading pregnancy care data platform and clinical services to improve maternal and child health outcomes.

‍About You: We are looking for a clinician who is passionate about patient engagement in nutrition, lactation, and lifestyle, and who is comfortable using technology to support better care. This is a combined role for someone who holds both Registered Dietitian and IBCLC credentials.

Responsibilities:

A) Nutrition and Lactation Care

  • Provide perinatal nutrition and lactation care for pregnancy and postpartum.
  • Provide 1:1 and group dietitian and and lactation visits by video, phone, and app.
  • Manage nutrition care for the pregnancy and postpartum journey including gestational diabetes and for Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes in pregnancy.
  • Teach and lead group lactation support and education classes.
  • Create breastfeeding and chestfeeding protocols and safety measures for a telemedicine platform.

B) Protocols and Patient Content

  • Build and maintain nutrition and lactation protocols and safety measures for virtual care.
  • Update protocols and procedures as needed to keep care safe and effective.
  • Create app-based patient content that supports learning and success.

C) Growth and Team Support

  • Obtain additional state dietitian licenses over time to support patients as Delfina expands into new states.
  • As the dietitian team grows, help support and guide other Registered Dietitians and Lactation Consultants within Delfina Medical Group.

Qualifications:

  • Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with at least a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Active International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC).
  • Licensed to practice as a dietitian in at least three of the following states:
    • Maryland
    • Nevada
    • Illinois
    • Texas
  • Willing to obtain additional state licenses.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish. This is required.
  • Two or more years providing pregnancy-related nutrition care, including management of gestational diabetes and Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) certification, or the clinical experience to be CDCES-eligible(Preferred)
  • One or more years of experience practicing as an IBCLC in the prenatal and postpartum setting.
  • Previous experience providing virtual patient care.

Virtual Work Requirements

  • A private location with reliable high-speed internet suitable for patient visits.
  • Comfort working by video, phone, text, and app-based tools.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Full-time, salaried position (or part-time upon interest).
  • Health insurance benefits.
  • Starter 401(k) plan available for employee contributions (non-matching).
  • Support for maintaining multi-state licensure.

We value that everyone at Delfina brings a unique background and perspective. Prospective applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet 100% of the listed qualifications and are encouraged to use their resume and other application materials to demonstrate how their skills meet, or are equivalent to, the listed qualifications.

Compensation: $94,000-$110,000 USD annually

The base salary range for this full-time position in the United States represents a wide variety of factors, including location, skills, experience, education, and training. New hires who meet most of the qualifications above should expect to earn near the middle of the posted salary range.

Delfina Medical Group provides equal opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or family status, national origin, age, veteran or disability status.

Note that Delfina Medical Group does not sponsor or facilitate any U.S. work authorization. All applicants must have unrestricted and independent authorization to work at Delfina.

raw.excerpt: About PhorestWould you like to create the future of a product used by thousands of businesses and millions of consumers?
raw.description:
About Phorest

Would you like to create the future of a product used by thousands of businesses and millions of consumers? Phorest Salon Software powers over 11,000 hair and beauty salons in Ireland, UK, Germany, Australia, Finland, USA, Canada, UAE and Netherlands and the platform processes 7 million appointments a month for hair and beauty consumers. Phorest is the number 1 salon software brand for premium independent salons in those markets and our next goal is to become a platform upon which other companies can build applications for premium salons.

Our system touches every point of the salon experience. We have the in-salon software desktop application, Phorest Go (the native staff application), online bookings website for salons, and custom native apps per salon. In a typical month, Phorest processes 3 million appointments and we send over 3 million SMS and 4 million emails. We process 200k online bookings per month and over 150 custom built white label native apps.

The Opportunity

We’re adding to our security capability and we are looking for someone who can move the needle, not a ticket-taker, but an experienced engineer who takes initiative, builds things, and genuinely partners with our product and engineering teams and the wider business. You’ll use your deep security expertise not only to solve complex problems, but to raise the security capability of the teams around you.

Reactive work eats into time that should be spent on proactive, strategic programmes. You will change that dynamic: by building security tooling and processes that scale, identifying risks and capability gaps, and turning them into impactful improvements. By embedding yourself in our engineering culture you’ll make security an integral part of how teams build and enable engineers to make good security decisions.

You will function primarily as an enabler, working across our stream-aligned engineering teams to build security knowledge, tooling, and practice where the work actually happens. An integral part of your impact will come through coaching others, sharing knowledge and creating scalable practices that raise the security bar for our Engineering Team.

What You'll Do

You will own security engineering outcomes - acting as SME, identifying cross-functional opportunities, and driving improvements through to impact.

Security Platform & Developer Tooling

  • Partner with engineering teams to introduce tooling that makes secure coding the path of least resistance. Identify opportunities to improve the security experience and take ownership of delivering improvements that materially reduce risk or friction.

  • Collaborate with platform engineers to weave security into CI/CD pipelines, our cloud environment and code review workflows, without creating friction or bottlenecks. Establish reusable patterns and practices that enable teams to adopt secure-by-default approaches.

  • Work with engineering leads to identify and prioritise process & tooling improvements against our real risk landscape, building shared agreement on what matters most.

Developer Enablement & Partnership

  • Proactively identify security knowledge and capability gaps, and build confidence across Phorest engineering through collaborative threat-modelling sessions, documentation, and hands-on pairing, so teams can make good security decisions independently.

  • Embed with stream-aligned product teams at key stages like design, architecture review, pre-launch to provide security input as a trusted peer, not an external auditor. Coach teams through complex security decisions, helping them build their own capability.

  • Act as a subject matter expert and trusted partner between Security and Product & Engineering, helping teams understand security and compliance requirements.

  • Share security learnings, emerging threats and lessons from incidents across Engineering, creating reusable guidance that raises the baseline of secure engineering and proactively creates awareness for how teams consider security.

Security Monitoring & Risk Understanding

  • Work alongside the broader security and IT team to proactively monitor security signals and alerts, identify patterns and build shared situational awareness across the team.

  • Identify and assess emerging security risks and opportunities, conduct exploratory risk analysis that shapes the security programme roadmap, bringing in the engineering perspective you've built through close team relationships.

  • Build out security requirements and review processes for our AWS-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS environment.

  • Contribute to the on-call rota, providing security coverage for incidents as they arise.

  • Support security incident response end to end, from initial triage and containment through to post-incident review and remediation tracking.

Who You Are

You take initiative.

We’re looking for someone that creates momentum over responding to demand, we need someone who sees a risk or an opportunity, develops a point of view, and moves, keeping stakeholders informed along the way. You are comfortable defining the problem, deciding your approach and owning the outcome.

You can bridge technical and non-technical worlds.

Phorest's engineering teams are sharp and want genuine security partnership, but not everyone in the company is technical, so you will need to be credible with both explaining risk clearly to technical and non technical audiences, and translating security requirements into practical engineering guidance.

You have a proactive growth mindset.

You seek feedback, challenge the status quo, embrace ambiguity and turn what you learn into action — sharing knowledge and raising the capability of those around you.

You are technically grounded.

  • Demonstrable Hands-on secure development experience (preferably 7+ years); you have written production code at some point in your career.

  • Deep enough experience in a security engineering or application security role to act as a subject matter expert for complex security challenges..

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate security work, generating, and analysing at pace while keeping your human judgment at the center of every decision.

  • Strong working knowledge of AWS security, IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, and related services.

  • Familiarity with common vulnerability classes, OWASP, and secure SDLC frameworks.

  • Comfortable working across SaaS, multi-tenant architectures.

You bring the soft skills.

  • Strong communicator, written, verbal, and async.

  • Able to build trust with engineering teams without relying on authority.

  • Proactive in keeping stakeholders informed; you surface problems early rather than waiting to have answers.

  • Comfortable working in a distributed team where you own outcomes end to end.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience working in a payments or regulated SaaS environment (PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA).

Familiarity with Team Topologies or other platform/enabling team models.

Exposure to offensive security techniques, penetration testing, red teaming, or bug bounty.

Experience building security enablement or champion programmes that improve security capability and ownership across an engineering organisation.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

description: EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing.

raw.title: AI Compiler Engineer
raw.excerpt: EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing.
raw.description:
EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.

About the Role

EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge’s Inference Accelerators.

Responsibilities

Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization.

  • Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.
  • Work on performance optimizations for neural network models, such as layer fusion, operator fusion, and graph-level transformations.
  • Develop compiler optimizations and passes that convert high-level AI models (e.g., from TensorFlow, PyTorch) into intermediate representations (IR).
  • Implement parsing, semantic analysis, and IR generation for deep learning frameworks.
  • Research and integrate the latest advancements in compiler design, ML model optimizations, and hardware acceleration into graph compilers.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of engineers focused on graph compiler optimizations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).
  • 3+ years in compiler development, with a strong focus on AI or ML graph compilers.
  • Proficiency in AI graph compiler frameworks (e.g., MLIR, Torch-FX)
  • Solid background in hardware architectures (e.g., GPUs, TPUs, ASICs) and optimization techniques such as fusion, quantization, and tiling.
  • Familiarity with neural networks operators and code generation.
  • Strong understanding of intermediate representations, code parsing, and semantic analysis in compiler design.
  • Proficiency in C++, Python, or other programming languages commonly used in compiler development.
  • Open-source contributions to AI software frameworks and libraries is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with successful project delivery.

EnCharge AI is an equal employment opportunity employer in the United States.

The salary range for this position is $190,000 to $255,000 USD per year. (Per Year: $195,000 to $265,000 CAD | €110,000 to €160,000 EUR | 1,206,458 to 1,754,848 NOK)
Actual compensation offered will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: The MissionCyberattack runs on internet infrastructure.

raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: The MissionCyberattack runs on internet infrastructure.
raw.description:
The Mission

Cyberattack runs on internet infrastructure. DomainTools maps it, and has for over 25 years.

The world's most advanced security teams rely on DomainTools to identify malicious infrastructure before it's used against them. We're not a company coasting on legacy. We're in an active growth phase: shipping new products, expanding our intelligence platform well beyond our DNS roots, and positioning at the center of where cybersecurity is heading in the age of AI.

Today, DomainTools delivers a comprehensive internet intelligence platform covering domains, IPs, hostnames, SSL certificates, passive DNS, real-time threat feeds, and AI-native integrations, with visibility into 97% of the internet. Our Iris platform, DNSDB, real-time threat feeds, and MCP Server are the intelligence backbone for security teams at Fortune 500 companies, U.S. federal agencies, and the world's most sophisticated SOCs.

We're not chasing a category. We define it, and we're accelerating.

The Opportunity

DomainTools is at an inflection point. Strong product-market fit. A platform expanding rapidly in capability and scope. A market shifting decisively toward AI-native security operations, where agentic SOC workflows are moving from concept to production and where the retirement of legacy threat intelligence platforms is creating a window of competitive opportunity that favors us.

This role owns how that intelligence is positioned, launched, and sold.

You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Research, Sales, and Demand Generation. You'll turn intelligence, and investigative capability into clear narratives for practitioners and economic buyers, then put those narratives into the assets the field actually uses. You'll write battle cards that sales reps reach for in competitive deals. You'll build launch plans that ship with a narrative, enablement, and a measured result. You'll know the threat intelligence market well enough to brief an analyst or a sales engineer without a handler in the room.

What You'll Own

Positioning and Messaging

  • Own the narrative for assigned products and use cases, including investigation, threat hunting, fraud and brand protection, detection enrichment, and API-first data consumption. Keep it current as the product and market evolve.
  • Write for two audiences at once: the SOC analyst or threat hunter who has to trust the data, and the CISO or SOC Director who has to justify the spend.
  • Maintain the messaging framework so the website, sales team, partners, and campaigns all say the same thing and mean it.
  • Translate technical depth into buyer language without flattening what makes DomainTools different: 25+ years of data, predictive Risk Scoring, guided infrastructure pivots, and AI-native access via the MCP Server.

Launches and Go-to-Market

  • Plan and run go-to-market for product launches and major releases in partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Demand Generation.
  • Define the full launch package: audience, narrative, asset list, enablement plan, and how you'll know it worked. Not just an announcement.
  • Translate the roadmap into a launch calendar the rest of the team can execute against, with enough lead time to do it well.
  • Own the AI and agentic SOC narrative as a launch pillar in its own right, positioning the MCP Server, AI-native workflows, and the shift from analyst-assisted to autonomous investigation as a coherent, compelling story for the market.

Sales and Partner Enablement

  • Build the field kit: first-call decks, solution briefs, battle cards, talk tracks, objection handlers, demo narratives, and proof points. Assets sales uses without rewriting.
  • Train sales and solutions engineering on positioning, competitive differentiation, and how to run a compelling DomainTools demonstration.
  • Join deals when the narrative needs an owner, including competitive situations, strategic accounts, and moments where the right framing changes the outcome.
  • Equip resellers and technology partners who embed or distribute DomainTools intelligence, including the security platforms and SIEM, SOAR, XDR, and TIP vendors we integrate with, with messaging that works for their buyers and go-to-market motion.

Market and Competitive Intelligence

  • Track how buyers evaluate Domain Tools data and intelligence against other solutions. Know the competitive landscape cold. Know what shifts in the threat intelligence market mean for our pipeline and positioning.
  • Run win/loss and competitive reviews on a regular cadence. Feed what you learn back to Product and Sales, not just into a document no one reads.
  • Bring a point of view to analyst conversations, partner briefings, and market-facing moments where DomainTools needs a voice.

Content and Proof

  • Partner with Research and Content on thought leadership tied to real adversary infrastructure, not generic cyber news. DomainTools has 25 years of data and a research team that uncovers things others can't see. Your job is to make that visible.
  • Produce or direct web copy, solution pages, blog posts, customer stories, and proof content that sales will actually forward.
  • Build the evidence base: customer outcomes, third-party validation data, investigation time benchmarks, and use-case proof points that make every claim land.

How We'll Know It's Working

  • Sales reaches for your assets in competitive deals, without rewriting them first.
  • Launches ship with a narrative, enablement, and a measured result, not just an announcement.
  • Win stories and competitive guidance get sharper each quarter.
  • Product and Sales can both describe the same differentiation, in the same language.
  • The market, including analysts, prospects, and partners, understands what DomainTools does and why it's different.

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years in B2B product marketing, with meaningful time in cybersecurity. Threat intelligence, DNS or domain data, fraud, security analytics, or SOC-facing products is a strong plus.
  • A portfolio that shows messaging, a launch, and sales assets, not only campaign work. We want to see the battle card, the brief, and the deck, not just the email sequence.
  • The ability to make technical products legible without flattening them. DomainTools buyers are practitioners. They'll know if you've oversimplified.
  • Comfort with enterprise security cycles, including intelligence buyers and vendors who consume data via API, not just UI-first buyers.
  • Enough cyber fluency to brief a sales engineer or a threat intelligence analyst without a handler in the room. You don't need to have been a SOC analyst, but you need to understand what one does.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI in security operations. The agentic SOC isn't a future state. It's happening now. You should have a point of view on what it means for how security teams buy, evaluate, and use intelligence tools.
  • Clear, confident writing. You'll write a significant portion of this job yourself, from solution briefs to competitive one-pagers to internal training decks.
  • Cross-functional instincts. You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Research, and Demand Gen. You'll influence and earn trust through the quality of your work.

Strong plus:

  • Hands-on experience with investigative or threat intelligence platforms.
  • Experience marketing API or data products, not only UI-first tools. DomainTools is increasingly consumed programmatically, via API, data feeds, and the MCP Server.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI workflows and how security teams are integrating LLMs into SOC operations. The MCP Server is a live, growing product and a central part of our story going forward.
  • Experience building or marketing within a technology partner or reseller ecosystem, particularly across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, or TIP platforms.
  • Analyst-relations or partner-marketing exposure.
  • Familiarity with SOC, fraud, or brand protection buying groups.
  • Experience marketing to or within the public sector or federal government.

Why DomainTools

The product is real, and growing fast. DomainTools has shipped more new capabilities in the past 12 months than in several prior years combined: real-time threat feeds, the MCP Server for AI-native security workflows, IrisQL for programmatic investigation, and a growing ecosystem of integrations across Splunk, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Google SecOps, and more. The roadmap is accelerating, not slowing.

The customers are the proof. Security teams at Fortune 500 companies, federal agencies, and the world's most sophisticated SOCs use DomainTools every day. The product earns its renewals. Your job is to make sure more of the right buyers find it.

The culture is real. We value integrity, customer focus, impact, teamwork, innovation, and joy. We love what we do, and it shows.

Compensation: $125K - $150K base salary, plus a 10% annual bonus

Benefits

DomainTools is the global leader for Internet intelligence and the first place security practitioners go when they need to know. The world’s most advanced security teams use our solutions to identify external risks, investigate threats, and proactively protect their organizations in a constantly evolving threat landscape. DomainTools constantly monitors the Internet and brings together the most comprehensive and trusted domain website and DNS data to provide immediate context and machine-learning driven risk analytics delivered in near real-time.

DomainTools offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees that includes fully paid medical, dental and vision insurance premiums, a 401k retirement plan with company matching, basic life insurance, flexible PTO and additional well-being benefits.

DomainTools embraces diversity, equity and inclusion to its fullest as an equal opportunity employer. We build our teams so creativity and innovation can flourish. We believe inclusivity and equity fosters innovation and growth, and we harness this mindset to drive a culture that serves our employees and our customers. We encourage people of all backgrounds, ages, perspectives and skill sets to apply; and do not discriminate based on age, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Walker Sands is one of the fastest-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a high-impact Sr. Manager, SEO + GEO to help fuel that continued growth. Total compensation for this role is expected to be between $77,500 - $89,000 per year.

As an agency, we exist to accelerate growth—for our clients, our people and the B2B industry. We partner with B2B technology and services companies, from high-growth Silicon Valley businesses to global Fortune 500 brands, to drive meaningful business results. At Walker Sands, curiosity sparks new ideas, collaboration makes the work stronger, and people are at the center of everything we do.

Walker Sands is looking for a Senior Manager who loves digging into how search works and helping clients get found. Search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) are part of our agency DNA. Our GEO work includes optimizing for AI-generated answers, an area you may know as answer engine optimization (AEO). We do innovative, cutting-edge work in Search and AI, exploring how they intersect with earned, owned, shared, and paid media. You’ll bring deep expertise to B2B client programs, collaborating on strategy and getting hands-on with technical audits, optimization, and measurement. We’re looking for someone who enjoys investigating difficult questions and testing new approaches.

As a Senior Manager, you’ll be a core member of account SEO and GEO teams and a subject matter expert who helps define priorities and turn ideas into effective client work. You’ll collaborate with account leads, senior strategists, and clients, and may serve as the lead on some engagements. Integrated marketing programs are the norm here: you’ll work with PR, content, social, paid media, web, and analytics teammates to connect search insights with their work and amplify results across channels.

What You Will Do (Responsibilities):

  • Collaborate with account leads and senior strategists to help define SEO and GEO strategies. Understand each client’s products, solutions, audiences, and business goals; use that context to set priorities and develop proactive, practical recommendations.
  • Independently manage assigned projects, workstreams, and deliverables across multiple client programs. Delegate work to interns, Specialists, and Senior Specialists as appropriate, providing clear direction and reviewing deliverables for quality. Use agency and client project management systems to organize work and keep execution moving.
  • Conduct and review technical SEO and GEO audits. Investigate crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and access for relevant search and AI crawlers. Work with web teams to implement and validate fixes.
  • Research keywords, buyer questions, AI prompts, competitors, and the publications, communities, and other sources that shape AI answers. Turn findings into content, website, and authority-building recommendations, collaborating with PR and content teams on opportunities to strengthen client visibility.
  • Develop content briefs and outlines that guide writers in creating content aligned with clients’ business goals and audience needs. Translate keyword, prompt, and audience research into clear direction on topics, structure, and questions to address, helping content perform in organic search and AI answers.
  • Develop and review content optimization recommendations for organic search and AI discovery, helping clients make their expertise clear, useful, credible, and relevant to buyers.
  • Help define measurement plans and prepare and review accurate, regular reporting for account and client leads. Analyze organic search performance, qualified traffic and conversions, AI visibility and share of voice, brand mentions, citations, and competitor trends. Explain findings and measurement limits, and provide actionable recommendations tied to client goals.
  • Collaborate in client conversations from onboarding through ongoing strategy and reporting. Explain complex concepts and deliver consultative strategic recommendations that align with clients’ business needs. Communicate strategy, findings, and metrics clearly to practitioners and executives, recommend solutions to roadblocks, and raise opportunities for other agency services with Client Services.
  • May manage direct reports or interns and coach teammates as team needs allow, including teaching research, technical methods, reporting, and interpretation through work reviews and training.
  • Partner with account leads on scope, priorities, and internal and client deadlines. Take responsibility for assigned deliverables and delegated work, communicate timeline changes early, and coordinate execution with other disciplines.
  • Use AI assistants for research, analysis, and developing ideas. Check sources and outputs, apply your judgment, and help the team improve its workflows.
  • Maintain a commitment to constant learning and experimentation, including staying current on SEO, GEO, analytics, and broader marketing trends. Test new approaches, share what you learn, and help turn successful experiments into repeatable methods the team can use across client programs.

Non-Negotiables:

  • You’re proactive. You don’t wait for direction; you bring ideas, solutions, and momentum.
  • You’recollaborative. You make the work better by working well with others.
  • You drive innovation. You stay ahead of platform changes, emerging tools, and new approaches - and help your team adopt them thoughtfully.

raw.title: Vocational Education Program Consultant (1099)
raw.excerpt: DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change.
raw.description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.

Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University, we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.

DeVry University is evaluating opportunities to expand its workforce-aligned education portfolio and is seeking an experienced vocational education leader to advise Product, Strategy, and Academics. Initial work will focus on assessing the feasibility of a potential electrical technician/electrician-focused program and developing recommendations related to market demand, program design, delivery model, operating requirements, and financial viability. Subject to the outcome of the feasibility assessment and institutional approval, the engagement may extend into detailed program design and launch planning. This is a hands-on advisory engagement for someone who has personally designed, launched, and scaled comparable programs and who understands both the academic architecture and operating economics of running one. The selected consultant will assess industry standards, licensure pathways, and employer demand and develop recommendations for a potential program designed to prepare graduates for relevant entry-level employment, apprenticeship opportunities, and, where applicable, future licensure requirements. Key Responsibilities Business Case and Market Validation

  • Partner with Product and Strategy to develop the business case, including labor-market demand, wage outcomes, competitive landscape, potential physical lab investments, site considerations, enrollment potential, and unit economics.
  • Distinguish clearly between validated market facts, working assumptions, and recommendations to support an informed leadership go/no-go decision.
  • Advise on potential pricing, cohort sizing, delivery models, including hybrid lab and online theory, and the capital and staffing considerations associated with hands-on instruction.

Program and Curriculum Design

  • Develop recommendations to inform a potential program's competency framework, course sequence, clock- or credit-hour structure, and lab and equipment requirements.
  • Assess alignment with recognized industry standards, including the National Electrical Code (NEC/NFPA 70), NCCER Core and Electrical curricula, OSHA 10/30, and relevant state licensure and U.S. Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship requirements.
  • Develop recommendations for potential articulation pathways into apprenticeships and journey-level opportunities, including opportunities associated with IBEW/NECA and other union or independent-contractor pathways, where applicable.

Industry and Employer Alignment

  • Advise on the potential development of an employer or industry advisory board to help ensure program recommendations reflect current field practices and hiring needs.
  • Develop recommendations for policies, processes, and outcome measures designed to assess alignment with applicable entry requirements for employment, apprenticeships, and state examinations.

Operational Readiness

  • Advise Academics on potential faculty qualifications, instructor-to-student ratios for lab safety, equipment sourcing, and facilities or lab-partner models.
  • Identify accreditation, state authorization, and program-approval considerations relevant to a potential skilled-trades diploma or degree program.
  • Develop recommendations and an implementation roadmap to inform a potential program launch, subject to institutional review and approval.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated subject-matter expertise in the electrical trade.
  • Direct experience designing, launching, and scaling vocational, CTE, or workforce programs at a higher education institution, community or technical college, trade school, or workforce-development organization.
  • Working knowledge of NEC, NCCER, OSHA, U.S. Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship standards, and state electrical licensure structures.
  • Business and operating fluency, with the ability to advise on program P&L, staffing models, equipment capital requirements, and enrollment economics in addition to instructional design.
  • Track record of developing employer partnerships and apprenticeship or job-placement pathways.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Licensed electrician, master electrician, or equivalent relevant industry credential.
  • Prior experience as a program director, dean, or department leader in a trades or workforce setting.
  • Experience with competency-based or clock-hour program models and accreditor or state-approval processes.
  • Familiarity with hybrid lab-plus-online delivery models for hands-on trades.

Engagement Details

  • Project-based consulting engagement structured around defined deliverables and project phases. Workload may vary based on project requirements and milestones
  • Estimated 20–40 hours per week during the business-case and design phases, with workload varying based on project milestones, deliverables, and engagement needs..
  • Defined deliverables by phase may include a business case, program blueprint, and potential launch plan, with established review gates.
  • This job will be posted for 30 days from the posting date.

  • 401k with up to 6% company match
  • Tuition assistance and career development opportunities
  • Remote & hybrid opportunities
  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, and mental health)
  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and volunteer time off
  • FSA/HSA options, disability & life insurance

Benefits vary based on employment status.

We are committed to a workplace environment where all colleagues feel valued, respected, and supported.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

  • Domain: AI-powered sales co-pilot
  • Location: Israel, USA
  • Company size: up to 10 employees
  • Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Join a forward-thinking technology company building intelligent systems that transform how people interact with digital experiences. Focused on the next generation of AI-driven applications, the company develops advanced solutions powered by large language models and real-time decision-making to create responsive, adaptive platforms.

If you’re passionate about building cutting-edge AI systems and want to help shape technology that can reason, adapt, and communicate instantly, this is an opportunity to contribute to a platform redefining intelligent interaction.

What makes you a great fit

  • Native or near-native English, comfortable leading calls with US customers, from end users to enterprise IT
  • Hands-on IT experience: SSO and identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or similar), MDM, VPNs, and user and group management
  • Strong Mac and Windows troubleshooting, including desktop app installs and OS-level permissions
  • Experience with CRM administration or integrations (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot), especially user permissions
  • A structured debugging approach: you can separate user error from a real bug and back it up with evidence
  • Ownership of deadlines and follow-ups across multiple customers at once
  • Experience in a technical support, support engineering, IT or implementation role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprises.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 admin, especially calendar app approvals
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and IT review processes
  • Basic scripting or log analysis skills for debugging
  • Startup experience.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own incoming technical issues end to end, from first report to resolution
  • Resolve issues directly with the customer, or debug them using our internal tools
  • Act as the filter before R&D: decide whether an issue is user error, a product knowledge gap, or a real bug
  • Coach users through product gaps so the same question doesn't come back
  • When it's a bug, confirm it with certainty, then report it to R&D with clear reproduction steps and context
  • Own the technical onboarding of each new pilot, from kickoff to go-live
  • Work with the customer's enterprise IT to set up SSO and identity provider access (Okta and other IdPs), including making sure every pilot user is in the groups allowed to access
  • Handle desktop app rollout on Mac and Windows: installation, OS permissions, and compatibility with the customer's MDM and VPN setup
  • Own CRM connection and onboarding, including working with the customer's CRM admin to make sure users have the right permissions
  • Lead onboarding meetings with customer IT teams and train them on the platform so they can complete the integration
  • Troubleshoot anything that blocks onboarding, and escalate to the CTO when needed
  • Drive follow-ups with customer stakeholders and hit the onboarding deadline committed for each customer.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

Our next steps

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

  • Domain: AI-powered sales co-pilot
  • Location: Israel, USA
  • Company size: up to 10 employees
  • Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Join a forward-thinking technology company building intelligent systems that transform how people interact with digital experiences. Focused on the next generation of AI-driven applications, the company develops advanced solutions powered by large language models and real-time decision-making to create responsive, adaptive platforms.

If you’re passionate about building cutting-edge AI systems and want to help shape technology that can reason, adapt, and communicate instantly, this is an opportunity to contribute to a platform redefining intelligent interaction.

What makes you a great fit

  • Native or near-native English, comfortable leading calls with US customers, from end users to enterprise IT
  • Hands-on IT experience: SSO and identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or similar), MDM, VPNs, and user and group management
  • Strong Mac and Windows troubleshooting, including desktop app installs and OS-level permissions
  • Experience with CRM administration or integrations (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot), especially user permissions
  • A structured debugging approach: you can separate user error from a real bug and back it up with evidence
  • Ownership of deadlines and follow-ups across multiple customers at once
  • Experience in a technical support, support engineering, IT or implementation role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprises.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 admin, especially calendar app approvals
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and IT review processes
  • Basic scripting or log analysis skills for debugging
  • Startup experience.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own incoming technical issues end to end, from first report to resolution
  • Resolve issues directly with the customer, or debug them using our internal tools
  • Act as the filter before R&D: decide whether an issue is user error, a product knowledge gap, or a real bug
  • Coach users through product gaps so the same question doesn't come back
  • When it's a bug, confirm it with certainty, then report it to R&D with clear reproduction steps and context
  • Own the technical onboarding of each new pilot, from kickoff to go-live
  • Work with the customer's enterprise IT to set up SSO and identity provider access (Okta and other IdPs), including making sure every pilot user is in the groups allowed to access
  • Handle desktop app rollout on Mac and Windows: installation, OS permissions, and compatibility with the customer's MDM and VPN setup
  • Own CRM connection and onboarding, including working with the customer's CRM admin to make sure users have the right permissions
  • Lead onboarding meetings with customer IT teams and train them on the platform so they can complete the integration
  • Troubleshoot anything that blocks onboarding, and escalate to the CTO when needed
  • Drive follow-ups with customer stakeholders and hit the onboarding deadline committed for each customer.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

Our next steps

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer

raw.description:
Amphenol Custom Cable is a leading provider of connectivity solutions with a strong national presence and global distribution network. Established in 1980, the company is a trusted partner to Fortune 500 organizations and is certified to TL9000:2008 and ISO 9001:2008 standards for excellence in manufacturing and installation connectivity services. Known for its rapid response, Amphenol Custom Cable delivers custom solutions that are efficient, cost-effective, and tailored to meet diverse customer needs. The company prides itself on providing quality, precision, and high performance for a wide range of requirements.

SUMMARY

The Product Development Engineer will prepare new fiber optic products for commercialization, provide and implement improvements for current manufacturing methods, and engage with existing customers to enhance user experience.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Will oversee fiber cable assembly engineering projects that are requested by the sales department (i.e., quotes, BOM creation, and new product request that can’t be configured on an online configuration tool).
  • Create and manage Bill of Materials (BOM) and drawings for new and existing products using ERP management and 2D/3D modeling software such as AutoCad and SolidWorks.
  • Lead and support the design, development, qualification, and improvement of fiber-optic products.
  • Apply strong knowledge of optical fiber, fiber optic cables, connectors, splicing, coatings, and related components.
  • Work with manufacturing to improve product performance, quality and cost.
  • Develop engineering specifications, test procedures, technical documentation, and product requirements.
  • Participate in new product introduction (NPI), design reviews, and engineering change processes.
  • Review other engineering team members drawings and BOMs for accuracy.
  • Responsible as the technical conduit between sales and engineering related to fiber optic cables, connectors, accessories, and/or assemblies.
  • Will interface with customers (in conjunction with sales) to provide technical support during the sales development process (phone calls, customer site visits, trade shows, etc).
  • Will work with engineering manager, fiber manufacturing engineer, and/or other departments to develop new products and solutions, as needed.
  • Provide process documentation and operating instructions for new products introduced to the production team.
  • Assist production to develop more efficient manufacturing procedures such as tooling, machinery, and processes and designing solutions to tackle those issues.
  • Creatively solve problems and develop methodologies to increase margin on products.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners on materials, components, and product performance.
  • Stay current with developments in fiber optic technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/industrial/electrical engineering/ manufacturing technology or equivalent; strong relevant experience in the fiber optic industry may be acceptable in lieu of degree.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in fiber optics, optical communications or related industry.
  • Strong technical understanding of fiber – optic cable assemblies.
  • Experience with fiber-optic product development, testing and qualification.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills including root cause analysis.
  • Ability to read and follow engineering and production documentation such as drawings, schematics, and process sheets.
  • Willingness to gets hands-on with products and machinery and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross functional engineering team.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with team members of different backgrounds.
  • Working knowledge of software tools (MS Office, AutoCad, and SolidWorks), Proficiency in CAD is a plus.

Why Join EPIC4?

  • Fully remote work environment

  • 401(k)

raw.excerpt: Dane to dla nas coś więcej niż modele. Jesteśmy częściąskandynawskiej grupy B3 Consulting.
raw.description:
Dane to dla nas coś więcej niż modele.

Jesteśmy częściąskandynawskiej grupy B3 Consulting.

Działamy z Warszawy, ale myślimy szerzej – o technologii, biznesie i ludziach, którzy za tym stoją.

W B3 realizujemy projekty data-driven i świadomie rozwijamy ten obszar dalej.

Rynek wyraźnie pokazuje kierunek:zaawansowana analityka, ML w produkcji, decyzje oparte na danych.

My już tam jesteśmy — i przygotowujemy się na kolejne projekty.

Dlatego zapraszamy do rozmowy Senior Data Scientistów / Analystów, którzy chcą być częścią tego kierunku.

Jak pracujemy?

  • łączymydobrze poukładane procesyzautonomią i sprawczością

  • cenimy doświadczenie, ale nie stoimy w miejscu

  • mówimy wprost, myślimy logicznie, działamy odpowiedzialnie

  • technologia jest ważna –ale ludzie i efekt są ważniejsi

Naszą wizją jestświat technologii, w którym na pierwszym miejscu są ludzie i odpowiedzialność za rezultat.

Co robimy w obszarze data?

W projektach, które realizujemy (i które są przed nami), pojawiają się m.in.:

  • budowa i rozwójmodeli ML działających w środowisku produkcyjnym

  • praca na danych o różnej naturze: tabelarycznych, czasowych, eventowych

  • skalowanie rozwiązań i dbanie o ich stabilność oraz jakość

  • ścisła współpraca z biznesem – od zrozumienia problemu po dowiezienie efektu

  • projektowanie rozwiązań, a nie tylko pojedynczych modeli

Zakres technologiczny i sposób pracy dopasowujemy do problemu, a nie odwrotnie.

Kogo chcemy poznać?

Osoby, które:

  • mają doświadczenie w Data Science / Advanced Analytics i wiedzą, jak wygląda praca z danymi w realnym środowisku

  • budowa i rozwójmodeli ML działających w środowisku produkcyjnym

  • brali udział wwdrażaniu rozwiązań do produkcji

  • potrafią myśleć systemowo i brać odpowiedzialność za efekt

  • dobrze czują się na stykudanych, technologii i biznesu

W naszych projektach pojawiają się m.in.:

  • Python, Scala, zaawansowany SQL

  • Spark, Databricks, BigQuery

  • GCP / Azure/ AWS

  • różne narzędzia do orkiestracji danych (np. Airflow), narzędzia do monitoringu

Dlaczego B3?

  • budujemy relacje i zespoły z wyprzedzeniem

  • dajemy seniorom realny wpływ

  • dzielimy sięenergią, logiką działania i zdrowym podejściem do rzeczywistości

  • działamy lokalnie, alez międzynarodową perspektywą

Brzmi jak coś, z czym chcesz być w kontakcie?

Nie musisz szukać zmiany „na już”.

Jeśli realizujesz projekty data na wysokim poziomie i chcesz być blisko organizacji, która aktywnie rozwija ten obszar – porozmawiajmy.

To zaproszenie do relacji.

raw.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The Industry Account Manager will develop and implement sales strategies and plans to meet, or exceed annual sales goals and grow our market share. Because you have demonstrated how our products, information software and solutions will benefit the customers operation and bottom line, those customers will rely on you for answers and future solutions – and grow their spend with us.


Responsibilities - What you will do:

  • Become the expert your customers need. Understand their industry (applications, standards/regulations, drivers & trends), their own organization and how things get done, what they want to accomplish and how our offerings and partner capabilities will help them achieve those goals
  • Manage the strategy for growing your accounts, and talking to your extended team about your plans so they can support you
  • Develop into a trusted advisor. You will understand their processes, plans and organization model so well that you can offer application knowledge, industry expertise and guidance on their projects
  • Influence decisions. You'll qualify customer opportunities, engage resources, and coordinate the solution design and presentation so the customer chooses our solution for all the right reasons
  • Collaborate. You'll work with Industry Managers and your broader account team, senior management and a technical engagement team (domain experts) to plan for and win opportunities
  • Look ahead. We have the platform, Dynamics Customer Relationship Management system, and the processes to maintain accurate assessments of targets and opportunities in the funnel
  • Negotiate. You'll team with your colleagues in Contracts and Negotiations to offer the best contract terms and conditions (T&Cs), pricing, discounts and allowances, and obtain agreements and prices to support the proposal effort
  • Manage. That includes customer/internal account reviews, and internal/external partner expectations

Qualifications - You Will Have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience
  • Valid Drivers' License

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

  • 5 years' experience in industrial automation
  • 5 years' experience in technical sales, industrial distribution, systems integration or an engineering firm, or graduate of the Rockwell Automation Sales Training Program
  • Experience selling to accounts in the food and beverage and agriculture business.
  • Ability to travel 40% of time.
  • Sell at the senior management & executive levels and convey Rockwell Automation's products & services in a manner which demonstrate tangible economic value.
  • Industrial software experience

What We Offer:

  • Health Insurance including Medical and Dental
  • Health Care Spending Account (HCSA – dependent on the plan chosen)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement plans
  • Paid Time off
  • Volunteering Time off
  • Employer Savings Plan Matching (includes RRSP, TFSA, and EPSP)
  • Employer Paid DC Pension
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up

Willst du Innovation und Natur verbinden? Project Bay ist Europas führendes Netzwerk für Workation und CoWorking mit direktem Zugang zur Ostsee und Standorten in ganz Europa. Wir sind Vorreiter in der Verbindung von Digitalisierung, Nachhaltigkeit und regionaler Entwicklung.

Unsere Mission: Ländliche Regionen durch smarte Arbeitsmodelle und moderne Technologien stärken. Von flexiblen Arbeitsplätzen über Breakout-Sessions bis hin zu Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten und Fortbildungen – wir bieten alles, was Teams und Einzelpersonen brauchen, um produktiv und inspiriert zu arbeiten.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte die Zukunft von Workation und Nachhaltigkeit in Europa mit!

This is a remote position.

IT Support Engineer | USA

Location: USA

Type: (Remote / Hybrid)

Experience: 2–5 Years

Employment: Full-Time

Company Description

Twenty5 is an innovative software company specializing in bringing business value to project-centric industries, including Aerospace & Defense, Professional Services, and Capital Projects. By leveraging advances in predictive analysis and AI, Twenty5 optimizes pricing and cost estimation processes, making them more efficient and data-driven. By utilizing project knowledge and performance insights, we support businesses in delivering precise and effective project proposals with ease.

Role Description

We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Technical Support Engineer to join our US-based support team. Our product is a feature-rich enterprise application built on top of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Tomcat , running on Java, ExtJS, and JavaScript, with SAP HANA as the database backend.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting end users and enterprise clients during US business hours, diagnosing and resolving application and infrastructure issues, assisting with product installations and configuration, and collaborating closely with the engineering team to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.

This is a hands-on technical support role — not a DevOps or development position. You will be expected to learn the product deeply, understand its architecture, and become the go-to expert for troubleshooting across the full stack. We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to grow your skillset as our product evolves.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Support & Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the primary technical support point of contact for US-based clients during business hours.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to the application, including UI (ExtJS/JavaScript), backend (Java), and database (SAP HANA) layers.

  • Triage incoming support tickets, reproduce issues in test environments, and drive resolution within SLA commitments.

  • Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes of failures, performance bottlenecks, and configuration errors.

  • Collaborate with the engineering and product teams to escalate bugs and complex technical issues with clear, detailed documentation.

2. Application Installation & Configuration

  • Assist clients and internal teams with installation, deployment, and configuration of the application on SAP BTP.

  • Support Docker-based deployments, including troubleshooting container startup, networking, and runtime issues.

  • Configure and validate SSO/SAML-based authentication integrations between the application and client identity providers.

  • Manage and validate BTP-specific configurations such as destinations, service bindings, and environment variables.

  • Execute Shell scripts for environment setup, log collection, and routine maintenance tasks.
