This is a remote position.

Senior Functional Consultant – SAP, Aerospace & Defense / Manufacturing

Location: United States — Remote
Travel: Up to 20–30%, based on client needs
Salary Range: $90,000–$150,000 annually, based on experience
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Twenty5

Twenty5 helps project-centric organizations deliver better outcomes through AI, predictive analytics, and modern enterprise technology. We partner with clients across Aerospace & Defense, Manufacturing, Professional Services, and Capital Projects to modernize how they plan, price, cost, and run complex projects. Our platform is built natively on SAP Business Technology Platform.

We're a remote-first, globally connected team that values practical problem-solving, accountability, and real client impact.

About the Role

We're seeking an experienced Senior Functional Consultant who understands SAP-enabled manufacturing and has worked in or alongside Aerospace & Defense, government contracting, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

This is a hands-on, client-facing functional role. You'll work directly with business stakeholders to understand their operations, document requirements, map processes, configure solutions, and support successful implementations of the Twenty5 platform and related ERP and CRM systems.

The strongest candidates understand how manufacturing organizations actually run, not just how the software works. You can hold a credible conversation about product costing, project-based manufacturing, production planning, materials, order settlement, and quality with both a shop-floor lead and a CFO.

This is not an SAP developer, ABAP, BTP, or Basis role. We're looking for a functional consultant who has owned business processes, configuration, requirements, and testing with real end users.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with customers to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements.
  • Lead discovery sessions and translate business needs into practical functional solutions.
  • Analyze current-state processes and design improved future-state workflows.
  • Configure and support the Twenty5 platform and related enterprise solutions.
  • Support ERP and CRM implementations, including configuration, data mapping, integrations, testing, documentation, training, and deployment.
  • Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT): build test scenarios, coordinate defect resolution, and confirm solutions meet requirements.
  • Apply manufacturing and A&D knowledge to problems involving costing, production, materials, quality, project delivery, and operational reporting.
  • Work across finance, manufacturing, supply chain, project management, IT, and technical teams.
  • Write or interpret SQL queries when needed for reporting, analysis, validation, or troubleshooting.
  • Produce clear functional specifications, process maps, user stories, configuration documentation, and test scripts.
  • Provide ongoing functional support and recommend process and system improvements.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5–10+ years of functional consulting, ERP functional analysis, or business systems analysis experience.
  • Hands-on experience supporting manufacturing business processes.
  • Experience with Aerospace & Defense, government contractors, aviation, or another complex, highly regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Strong understanding of one or more of: product costing and cost object controlling; project-based, engineer-to-order, or make-to-order manufacturing; production planning and manufacturing execution; project accounting and order settlement; materials management and procurement; BOMs, routings, MRP, inventory, or quality processes; finance and controlling in a manufacturing context.
  • A track record of gathering requirements, mapping processes, configuring solutions, and supporting end users.
  • Demonstrated ownership of SIT and UAT.
  • Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a remote environment.

Preferred SAP Experience

Strongly preferred in one or more areas:

  • SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC
  • SAP Product Costing (CO-PC)
  • SAP Project Systems (PS)
  • SAP Production Planning (PP)
  • SAP Materials Management (MM)
  • SAP Quality Management (QM)
  • SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)
  • Cross-module integration across Finance, Manufacturing, Projects, Materials, and Sales
  • Full-cycle SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, or transformation projects

Candidates with exceptional A&D and manufacturing-process expertise on another major ERP platform will still be considered if they can pick up new systems quickly. If you're deep on one side (domain or SAP) and lighter on the other, apply anyway and tell us where your strength is.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Direct functional experience with an A&D manufacturer, government contractor, or a consulting practice serving A&D clients.
  • Hands-on SAP configuration experience, not solely project coordination or technical development.
  • Product Costing, Controlling, or Project Systems experience in a project-driven manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of government-contract manufacturing: contract structures, project accounting, traceability, compliance, or customer-specific access requirements.
  • Experience leading client workshops and advising business leaders on process improvements.

What Success Looks Like

In your first several months, you'll:

  • Build a strong understanding of the Twenty5 platform, our customers, and our implementation approach.
  • Earn credibility with client stakeholders by understanding both their business and their technology.
  • Independently lead requirements and process-discovery conversations.
  • Produce clear, actionable functional documentation.
  • Support configuration, testing, deployment, and adoption of solutions that solve real operational problems.
  • Spot opportunities to improve customer processes and strengthen outcomes.

Why Join Twenty5

  • Visible impact at a growing enterprise software company.
  • Direct work with leading Aerospace & Defense and manufacturing organizations.
  • A role at the intersection of enterprise technology, AI, predictive analytics, and operational transformation.
  • A collaborative, high-performing global team and a remote-first culture.
  • Meaningful client-facing work with real room to grow as we scale.

Eligibility and Work Authorization

Some Twenty5 engagements involve access to technical data governed by U.S. export control laws (ITAR and EAR). For those engagements, applicants must qualify as a "U.S. person" as defined under those regulations, which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status.

Applicants must also:

  • Reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.
  • Be able to travel up to 20–30% when required.
  • Be able to meet applicable client-specific, contractual, background-screening, or system-access requirements, which will be discussed during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity

Twenty5 is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, consistent with applicable law. We do not discriminate on the basis of citizenship, immigration status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Account Manager is a quota-carrying sales role focused exclusively on generating incremental annual recurring revenue (ARR) through cross-sell and upsell within STACK’s existing customer base. This person proactively hunts for expansion opportunities, builds their own pipeline, and owns the expansion sales process from prospecting through close.

The Account Manager works in concert with the Customer Success (CS) team to understand customer goals, product usage, and business needs, then translates those insights into qualified expansion opportunities. CS provides customer context and coordinates ongoing success activities; the Account Manager owns proactive expansion outreach, commercial discovery, proposals, negotiation, and closing.

This role does not own renewals, customer support, or retention management. Success is measured primarily by self-generated expansion ARR that the Account Manager proactively sources and closes within the customer base.

What You'll Do:

  • Consistently meet or exceed quota for self-generated expansion ARR through cross-sell and upsell to existing customers.
  • Proactively prospect within assigned accounts through targeted calls, email, and other appropriate channels to uncover unmet needs and expansion opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities for additional licenses, higher-tier packages, complementary products, and recurring add-ons that align with customer needs.
  • Build and maintain a qualified expansion pipeline through account research, outbound outreach, stakeholder development, and disciplined follow-up.
  • Own the end-to-end expansion sales process, including discovery, qualification, value demonstration, business case development, proposals, negotiation, and close.
  • Develop account plans for priority customers that identify expansion potential, relevant workflows, stakeholder coverage, buying processes, and next actions.
  • Monitor and respond promptly to signals that identify high-value expansion targets within the existing customer base, including product usage patterns, interest in additional capabilities, license needs, and customer growth. Prioritize these accounts for proactive sales engagement, validate the opportunity through discovery, and convert relevant signals into qualified cross-sell and upsell pipeline.
  • Work in concert with CS on account priorities, customer context, outreach timing, and stakeholder introductions to deliver coordinated customer engagement.
  • Build relationships beyond existing contacts to reach decision-makers, economic buyers, additional teams, and business units with expansion potential.
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants and other internal resources to demonstrate solutions and validate expansion use cases.
  • Coordinate the handoff of closed expansion business to CS and relevant delivery teams so purchased products and licenses can be adopted successfully.
  • Route renewal questions, support requests, and account health concerns to the responsible teams while keeping expansion activity coordinated with CS.
  • Maintain accurate Salesforce records, including opportunity source, qualification, expansion ARR, stakeholders, next steps, close dates, and forecast categories.
  • Forecast expansion opportunities with discipline and communicate pipeline gaps, deal risks, and actions needed to achieve quota.
  • Stay current on construction workflows, STACK capabilities, and competitive alternatives to position expansion solutions effectively.

Success Metrics

The primary measure of success is self-generated expansion ARR closed against quota. Self-generated ARR means incremental recurring revenue from cross-sell or upsell opportunities that the Account Manager proactively identifies, initiates, and advances to close. Renewed baseline ARR, automatic price increases, and one-time services revenue are not included in this measure.

CS collaboration informs and supports the sales motion; opportunity sourcing must be documented accurately so proactive AM hunting can be distinguished from inbound customer requests or opportunities originated by other teams.

  • Self-generated expansion ARR closed and attainment against quota.
  • Qualified expansion pipeline created through proactive hunting.
  • Conversion of self-generated opportunities into closed expansion business.
  • Expansion forecast accuracy and timely, complete Salesforce documentation.
  • Timely follow-up on high-value account signals, effective account prioritization, stakeholder coverage, and coordination with CS.

Renewal rate, GRR, support resolution, and customer adoption are not quota measures for this role. The Account Manager uses customer context to guide expansion activity and partners with the teams accountable for those outcomes.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in account management, account executive, or existing-business expansion roles.
  • Demonstrated success proactively sourcing and closing cross-sell and upsell opportunities within an existing customer base.
  • Proven ability to build pipeline independently through outbound prospecting, account research, and stakeholder development.
  • Experience owning discovery, qualification, value positioning, pipeline management, forecasting, negotiation, and closing.
  • Strong commercial judgment with the ability to identify customer needs, quantify business value, and recommend relevant solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills with executives, economic buyers, operational leaders, and end users.
  • Ability to partner effectively with CS and coordinate internal resources while maintaining clear ownership of expansion sales.
  • Strong organization and Salesforce or CRM discipline across multiple accounts and opportunities.
  • A proactive hunting mindset, consistent follow-through, and accountability for measurable revenue results.
  • Willingness to embrace feedback and continuously improve sales execution.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in construction technology, estimating, takeoff, project management software, or other vertical SaaS environments.
  • Familiarity with Challenger, MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, SPICED, Sandler, or similar sales and qualification frameworks.
  • Experience selling additional products, licenses, or packages into SMB or mid-market customer accounts.
  • Comfort using product usage data and account signals to target outbound expansion efforts.
  • Experience partnering with CS and Solutions Consultants on coordinated account expansion.

Candidate Profile

The ideal Account Manager is a proactive seller who operates like an Account Executive within an existing customer base. They uncover expansion opportunities before a customer asks, build relationships with new stakeholders, and turn customer needs into a clear business case for additional investment in STACK.

They bring urgency and structure to prospecting and pipeline management, take ownership of self-generated revenue, and work closely with CS to align expansion outreach with the customer’s experience and goals.

Why This Role Matters

STACK’s existing customer base is a significant source of expansion opportunity. The Account Manager helps capture that opportunity through a dedicated sales motion that brings additional products, licenses, and capabilities to customers with relevant needs. This role directly contributes incremental ARR through proactive hunting and disciplined closing, supported by a strong partnership with CS.

raw.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

Role Overview

RTS is seeking a Director of Strategy & FP&A to help shape and execute the company's strategic priorities while leading its financial planning and analysis function across its global esports, live events, media, e-commerce, and partnership businesses. Reporting directly to the CFO, this highly visible, hands-on role will serve as a key strategic and financial thought partner to the CEO, Chairman of the Board, and senior leadership team on the company's most critical initiatives.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, finance, and operations, with responsibility for overseeing FP&A, including budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, financial and operational analysis, and management reporting. The Director will work closely with the CFO and business leaders to challenge assumptions, connect financial performance with strategic priorities, and translate complex financial, operational, and market data into clear, decision-oriented insights and recommendations.

Strategy and FP&A will serve as the analytical foundation for one of the role's most important responsibilities: owning the end-to-end Board of Directors presentation process. This includes financial analysis, storyline development, executive synthesis, and final presentation development, ensuring that strategy, operating performance, financial outlook, key risks, and management priorities are presented as a cohesive narrative. The Director will also anticipate the Board's questions and ensure management is prepared with the analysis and context needed to address them.

This role is ideally suited for someone with experience in management consulting, strategic finance, FP&A, or corporate strategy who combines structured, data-driven thinking with strong financial acumen and exceptional executive storytelling skills. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on, from reviewing and building financial models and analyses to developing Board-level presentations and helping translate high-level strategy into execution.

Reporting Structure

You will report to the Chief Financial Officer, with significant direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership team.

Key Responsibilities
Board Reporting, Strategic Analysis & Decision Support
  • Own and drive the end-to-end Board of Directors presentation process, including storyline development, coordination of inputs, analysis, executive synthesis, and preparation of final Board materials.
  • Partner closely with the CFO and CEO to develop a clear and cohesive Board narrative that connects strategy, operating performance, financial outlook, key risks, and management priorities.

AI Software Engineer, Agent Harness

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (or throughout India remote-friendly with travel)

About EnCharge AI

EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in-memory-computing architecture delivers a 10x step-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon & systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation.

The Opportunity

We serve open-weight models and our own bespoke checkpoints on EnCharge hardware. The models change often, and the harness around them needs to keep up. You own this layer that runs agents against files, tools, documents with permissions, memory, unattended execution, and real outputs. It will be assembled from a combination of open-source and bespoke code.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the harness architecture end to end — agent loop, safe execution, context management, knowledge base, memory, permissions, orchestration, outputs, interfaces, observability — one component per layer, with clear interfaces so layers can be swapped.
  • Build the pieces with no open-source equivalent e.g. session semantics, enforced permissions, memory in a human-editable file, orchestrator, and outputs.
  • Keep pace with the models: adapters, prompt formats, tool-call schemas, stop conditions, benchmarking and evaluation.
  • Make tool use reliable across models of uneven tool-calling quality — validation, repair, retries, fallbacks.
  • Develop agents, tools, and MCP servers for internal and customer use cases, and review them for security before they ship.
  • Build the evaluation harness: task suites, regression runs on every model or harness change, cost and latency per task alongside quality.
  • Define the interfaces: session API, CLI, GUI, and an endpoint existing tools can point at.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience in backend systems or ML infrastructure
  • Strong Python and at least one systems language (e.g., Go, Rust, C++)
  • Have shipped and operated an agent loop in production — tool use, multi-step workflows, unattended runs
  • Hands-on with RAG, context management, and memory for LLM applications
  • Experience with sandboxing, isolation, and permission models for automated systems
  • Have run open-weight models yourself and understand how quantization and serving choices change model behavior
  • Comfort in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you define the roadmap; strong product instincts

Nice to Have

  • Contributions to open-source agent harnesses or coding agents
  • Experience with agent benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench) and building internal task suites
  • MoE serving familiarity e.g. expert placement, tensor parallelism, quantization etc.
  • Observability for LLM systems
  • Document parsing and indexing pipelines
  • Desktop or GUI application experience

raw.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Role Overview

The Senior Solutions Architect exists to guide enterprise customers through complex migrations from legacy identity and directory architectures to JumpCloud's Open Directory Platform. As enterprise customer engagements scale, this role addresses the critical need for dedicated domain subject matter experts (SMEs) across complex ecosystems involving cloud directory integrations, conditional access policies, MFA configurations, PAM, and multi-OS device management to drive structured, repeatable deployments. You will serve as the trusted technical authority bridging customer business requirements with robust architectural execution while establishing clear deployment milestones that drive platform adoption and time-to-value. By leading high-stakes enterprise engagements and contributing to Go-to-Market technical enablement, you will directly accelerate JumpCloud's enterprise retention, expansion, and customer delight.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Purpose: Act as a high-impact technical advisor empowering global organizations to modernize identity management, consolidate disparate tooling, and establish secure access architectures via JumpCloud's Open Directory Platform.
  • Growth: Establish and own org-wide Subject Matter Expertise across enterprise IAM, complex Microsoft ecosystems, and modern device management, while expanding leadership influence across GTM functions, architectural standards, and team enablement.
  • Motivators: Exercise autonomous ownership over complex enterprise deployments, solve multi-faceted architectural challenges, and collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders in a high-growth, modern cloud identity company.

Major Performance Objectives:

    1. Within the first 6 months, independently facilitate comprehensive discovery sessions and technical workshops for your assigned Professional Services engagements and related Projects, defining clear migration milestones and technical roadmaps while mitigating architectural scope gaps and mastering your knowledge of the JumpCloud platform.
    2. By Month 6, successfully execute hands-on technical deployments and directory cutovers (including Active Directory, Okta, and Google Workspace migrations) associated with your migration Projects. This will mark your first delivery of time-to-value and MVP metrics.
    3. Within 9 months, you will have completed your first projects and begun engaging more heavily with your Enterprise Projects. Success metrics are established, and your Enterprise Projects are on-track. You will be familiar with scoping, discovering, planning and executing across the entire JumpCloud customer lifecycle.
    4. Within and beyond 12 months, you will be managing ongoing high-complexity enterprise customer engagements in partnership with Customer Success counterparts, achieving target deployment milestones. You will be maintaining and improving your core metrics and contributing to your technical area of expertise in the form of technical documentation and guides, cross-departmental collaborations, and involvement in other go-to-market efforts and strategic technical conversations. You will begin using your knowledge to update internal processes and knowledge, and act as a mentor for newer team members.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • Must-have functional skills:

    • Enterprise identity architecture design and technical discovery facilitation for large-scale customer environments.

    • Proven track record executing end-to-end directory migrations and integrations that enable automated JML functions.

    • Deep technical implementation expertise in authentication and provisioning protocols (SAML 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, JIT, RADIUS).

    • Multi-OS device management and policy deployment across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

    • Preferred domain knowledge:

      • Advanced understanding of complex Microsoft enterprise ecosystems (Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, Intune, Microsoft 365, AVD).

      • Enterprise identity governance, zero-trust security frameworks, and network authentication mechanisms (SSH, SMB/Samba, Kerberos).

      • Professional Services delivery methodologies, structured customer engagement governance, and adoption tracking.

      • Tools or systems knowledge:

        • JumpCloud Admin Console or equivalent cloud identity and directory platforms.

        • Identity and Directory Providers: Microsoft Active Directory, Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace.

        • Device Management / MDM: Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM (ABM/ASM), Jamf, Iru, ME, etc.

        • Agentic tooling and effective LLM usage: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, MCPs.

        • Scripting and automation tools: PowerShell, Bash, and REST APIs.

        • Behavioral or power skills:

          • High-conviction technical communication with the ability to articulate complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical admins and executive stakeholders.

          • Structured analytical problem-solving and rigorous time management across concurrent customer engagements.

          • Proactive cross-functional partnership across Customer Success, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Product teams.

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual compensation range for this role, depending on individual candidate level and experience, is $125,000 - $175,000, including base salary and any related bonuses or commissions.

In the US, JumpCloud® provides a comprehensive benefits package, with several medical plans to choose from including a high deductible HSA plan with employer contribution, two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending account (FSA), employee assistance program (EAP), short- and long-term disability, life insurance and a 401k savings plan with match. We have a flexible paid time off policy.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
All roles posted in United States locations do require that you be located within one of the 50 U.S. States. Our Headquarters is in the Denver/Boulder, CO area but as a remote company, you are able to work remotely anywhere in the U.S. If you would like to spend time in our offices in the Denver/Boulder area, you are welcome to do that as well.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

coac versteht sich als Impulsgeber und Enabler für datengetriebene Innovationen. Dein Beitrag

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Softwareentwicklung und KI bei coac spielst du eine wichtige Rolle in unserem Team. Du bringst deine frischen Ideen und deine Expertise ein und hilfst uns dabei, die Zukunft der KI zu gestalten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung: Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen in Python, wobei du deine Kenntnisse anwendest und vertiefst.
  • Innovation: Du erkundest neue Technologien wie SAP BTP und bringst deine Ideen für deren Einsatz in unsere Projekte ein.
  • Administration: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Systeme reibungslos laufen und behebst auftretende Probleme.
  • Datenanalyse: Du analysierst und interpretierst Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen und bereitest diese mithilfe von Reporting-Tools auf.

Dein Profil

  • KI-Enthusiast: Du bist Student (m/w/d) in den Bereichen Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Chemie oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung und hast im Idealfall erste Erfahrungen mit KI und Machine Learning.
  • Programmierkenntnisse: Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Python und bist motiviert, deine Fähigkeiten in dieser Sprache weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Datenbankkenntnisse: Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit SQL und bist in der Lage, Daten auszulesen und zu speichern
  • Linux-Kenntnisse: Du bist mit der Bedienung einer Linux-Konsole vertraut.
  • Selbständigkeit: Du springst ins kalte Wasser, bevor jemand auch nur auf die Idee kommt dich zu werfen.
  • Teamgeist: Du bringst Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist mit und freust dich auf die Zusammenarbeit mit einem dynamischen Team.
  • Sprachen: Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind auf muttersprachlichem Niveau; zudem verfügst du über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Angebot

  • Spannende Aufgaben: Du arbeitest an zukunftsweisenden Projekten mit und lernst von den besten Experten der Branche.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir bieten dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten, deine Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Perspektive: Wir suchen Menschen, die sich vorstellen können, nach dem Studium bei uns in das Berufsleben zu starten.
  • Dynamisches Team: Du wirst Teil eines motivierten internationalen Teams, das dich unterstützt und fördert.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir passen deine Arbeitszeiten an dein Studium an.

description: We are looking for a few Partnership interns who are passionate about the intersectionality between the private sector and the development industry and how to maximize the value that strategic collaborations between them can foster.

raw.title: Partnership Intern - Creative Gateway Refugee Project
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a few Partnership interns who are passionate about the intersectionality between the private sector and the development industry and how to maximize the value that strategic collaborations between them can foster.
raw.description:
We are looking for a few Partnership interns who are passionate about the intersectionality between the private sector and the development industry and how to maximize the value that strategic collaborations between them can foster.

You will be part of supporting youth in refugee camps throughout the world, starting from Kakuma in Kenya, home to over 280,000 refugees.

Our model involves teaching specific freelancing skills physically at the camps and then connecting them with companies once they graduate. Our first cohort was successful and we have a 100% success rate so far in landing gigs for graduates.

Now, we are looking to scale the project beyond only Kakuma to benefit youth at other refugee camps around Africa, such as Sudan, Somalia etc. Thereby, we are looking for contributors willing to invest time in the cause - and get invaluable experience and skills to propel you further in your career.

What we are doing is truly unique with its strong connection to the private sector. For this to work at scale, we need to come up with lean processes, investigate and maximize the value companies get from the collaboration, and onboard new and better private-sector partnerships for the next phases.

In this position, you will be contacting companies in the Nordics first hand - which revolves around experimenting with different approaches, having discussions with specific company decision makers, strategically onboard them to the project with value-add in mind, and navigating with the team in how to create specific content for onboarded partners.

The position is unpaid, while there might be opportunities later on.

The length of the internship is three (3) months.

raw.description:
gestalte mit uns die energiewende

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.
  • Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Messen, Veranstaltungen und vertriebsnahen Kommunikationsformaten mit.
  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.
  • Du pflegst CRM und Kundendaten zuverlässig und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen sauber dokumentiert und für das Team nutzbar sind.
  • Du bekommst einen umfassenden Einblick in Marketing und Sales eines innovativen Unternehmens der Energiewirtschaft, von Website Texten und LinkedIn Beiträgen über Kampagnen bis hin zu konkreten Vertriebsprojekten.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft, Energiewirtschaft oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher, Energiehandel und die Frage, wie wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen die Energiewende voranbringen können.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Themen sauber aufzubereiten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Du verfügst zwingend über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1/B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Inhalte klar, präzise und adressatengerecht formulieren.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Marketing-Content, Präsentationen oder Social Media Beiträgen sind von Vorteil.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, visuelle Kommunikation und saubere Unterlagen ist wünschenswert.
  • Du hast Lust auf die hands-on Mentalität eines jungen Start-ups und schätzt gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe

warum wir?

Wir sind ein Team aus Batteriespeicher-, Daten- und Energiemarktexpert:innen, die vorher teils bei
TESVOLT und teils in der Energie-Praxis bei anderen Scale-Ups, einschlägigen Beratungen und
Energieversorgern gearbeitet haben und bringen Know-how zu Batteriespeichern und

Energiehandel aus erster Hand mit.

Uns verbindet die Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Klimaschutz möglich ist – mit
klugen Ideen, starken Partnern und einem besonderen Team.

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft, des Energiehandels und der Flexibilitätsvermarktung von Batteriespeichern.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, nah an echten Projekten und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Management zusammen und bekommst dadurch einen breiten Blick auf ein wachsendes Geschäftsmodell.
  • Dich erwartet ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher fachlicher Nähe und der gemeinsamen Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Klimaschutz möglich ist.
  • Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, arbeitest überwiegend mobil und hast mit unserem Berliner Office einen gemeinsamen Anlaufpunkt für persönlichen Austausch.
  • Du arbeitest mit moderner technischer Ausstattung, digitalen Tools und einem professionellen Setup, das dir flexibles und effizientes Arbeiten von Anfang an ermöglicht

raw.title: Sales Director
raw.excerpt: About UsMaritime and Healthcare Group (MHG) is a globally recognized provider of comprehensive medical solutions tailored to the maritime industry.
raw.description:
About Us

Maritime and Healthcare Group (MHG) is a globally recognized provider of comprehensive medical solutions tailored to the maritime industry. We’ve been delivering innovative services since 2019, focusing on enhancing the safety, health, and well-being of seafarers worldwide. As an ISO and MLC certified company, we take pride in supporting leading cruise lines, cargo fleets, and offshore vessels with medical staffing, telemedicine, mental health programs, PEME management, and other shoreside services.

With growing demand for our services, we’re looking for a dynamic and experienced Sales Director to lead our commercial growth strategy, strengthen client relationships, and drive new business opportunities across the maritime sector.

Position Overview

The Sales Director will play a key role in expanding MHG’s footprint within the maritime industry. This individual will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, nurturing existing client relationships, and developing innovative sales strategies that align with our company’s growth objectives.

We are seeking a results-driven leader with a deep understanding of the maritime industry and a proven track record in B2B sales, particularly within the cruise, cargo, and offshore sectors.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Sales Strategy & Business Development:
    1. Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to drive revenue growth in the maritime sector.
    2. Identify and pursue new business opportunities with cruise lines, cargo fleets, offshore operators, and maritime agencies.
    3. Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline to ensure continuous new business generation.
  2. Client Relationship Management:
    1. Establish and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships.
    2. Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, ensuring their needs are met and expectations exceeded.
    3. Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address client challenges, particularly in areas such as medical staffing, telemedicine, PEME, and mental health support services.
  3. Market Insights & Competitor Analysis:
    1. Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and market dynamics in the maritime industry.
    2. Conduct regular competitor analysis to ensure MHG remains competitive in the marketplace.
  4. Collaboration & Leadership:
    1. Work closely with internal teams, including Operations, Marketing, and Clinical, to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.
    2. Represent MHG at key industry events, conferences, and client meetings.

raw.excerpt: Rollen som matrevisor/underleverandørRollen inkluderer revisjoner hos våre kunder i ulike deler av næringsmiddelindustrien fra jord til bord.
raw.description:
Rollen som matrevisor/underleverandørRollen inkluderer revisjoner hos våre kunder i ulike deler av næringsmiddelindustrien fra jord til bord. Det er en variert jobb med mye reising, hvor kundene befinner seg rundt om i Norge og Skandinavia, men også i andre deler av verden. Vi ser etter underleverandører innen både styringssystem og produktstandarder, som ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000, FSSC, BRC, IFS, GMP+ og MSC/ASCASC. Revisorer er kvalifisert for standarder og spesifikke bransjekoder basert på erfaring, utdanning og interesseområder.

Ansvar for deg som revisjonsleder inkluderer revisjon, rapportering og oppfølging av forbedringsområdene som er definert under revisjonene. Vi bruker hjemmekontor fordi vi har kunder over hele Norge, så vi er fleksible med hensyn til din plassering. Som matrevisor hos oss har du med andre ord stor innflytelse på hvordan arbeidstiden din fordeles og hvor mange oppdrag du er interessert i.

Som underleverandør har du allerede et konsulentselskap eller starter et, og får da oppdrag fra Intertek.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et internasjonalt miljø
  • Evne til å påvirke omfanget av oppgaver
  • Et inkluderende team
  • Kvalifisering innenfor de ulike standardene

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du har akademisk utdanning innen matfaget og minst 5 års arbeidserfaring innen mattrygghet, miljø og bærekraft fra ulike deler av matindustrien
  • Du har god kunnskap om styringssystemer og/eller har fungert som intern/ekstern revisor for mattrygghet, kvalitet og miljø i tidligere roller
  • Har du tidligere jobbet som matrevisor og/eller underleverandør innen matsertifisering, er det ekstra meritterende.
  • Du kan kommunisere på norsk og engelsk muntlig og skriftlig
  • Har førerkort

Vi legger stor vekt på dine personlige egenskaper. Som person er du drevet, pragmatisk, kreativ og lydhør. Du er utadvendt og kommunikativ samtidig som du er vant til selvstendig arbeid. Det kreves en god del initiativ for å takle rollen på en god måte. Videre har du med suksess kjørt og fullført prosjekter der din evne til å tenke helhetlig er testet. Du kan skape og vedlikeholde forretningsrelasjoner og ha en sterk faglig integritet.

Om IntertekMed mer enn 45 000 ansatte over hele verden er vi et av de største selskapene i vår bransje. I vårt daglige arbeid hjelper vi selskaper over hele verden med å sikre at produktene deres er trygge å bruke og oppfyller kundenes og myndighetenes krav til kvalitet og ytelse. Vi gjør dette ved å revidere prosessene deres, sertifisere styringssystemene deres, revidere leverandørene deres, teste, analysere og sertifisere produktene deres, inspisere produksjonsanlegg og forsendelser, og jobbe med råd om regulatoriske, kjemiske og bærekraftige spørsmål.

Hver dag streber vi etter å hjelpe våre kunder med å ha trygge og sosialt ansvarlige produkter og tjenester – Vi bringer kvalitet og sikkerhet til live!

Har vi fanget interessen din?
Velkommen med søknaden din i dag! Utvelgelsen av søknader er løpende, og vi oppfordrer deg derfor til å sende din CV så snart som mulig. Vi kan dessverre ikke behandle søknader via e-post, men søknaden gjøres via lenken.

Eventuelle spørsmål kan besvares av Jesper Nyman, Auditor Manager, .

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

raw.description:
Summary

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers transform the way they run their stores, making operations more data-led, agile and impactful. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn vast amounts of retail data into clear, actionable insights that influence decisions from store level to the C-suite.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now expanding our data capability in the US to support new global growth.

About Quorso

Quorso is one of retail’s most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalised daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we’re scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

The Opportunity

As an Implementation & Insights Consultant, you’ll sit at the heart of our customer analytics function, helping some of the world’s largest retailers make smarter, faster decisions. You’ll use SQL and BI tools to explore complex operational data, uncover trends, and turn those findings into clear, actionable insights.

You’ll work closely with our Customer, Product and Implementation teams to ensure that the data powering Quorso’s platform is accurate, meaningful, and easy for our clients to act on.

This is an analytical role focused on insight generation - not building data pipelines or warehouses.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with enterprise customer teams to understand business operations and define analytical requirements.

  • Use SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) to analyse large, messy retail datasets and surface meaningful insights.

  • Create dashboards and visualisations that highlight store performance, identify improvement opportunities and measure results.

  • Translate data findings into practical recommendations that drive operational excellence.

  • Collaborate with Product, Customer and Implementation teams to ensure our data stories connect with business priorities.

  • Continuously refine how we interpret and present data, improving clarity, speed and impact for internal teams and clients alike


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years’ experience in BI, analytics or data-driven decision support (ideally within retail, FMCG, or SaaS).

  • Strong SQL and Excel skills, with confidence working directly with complex datasets.

  • Experience creating reports or dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar.

  • An analytical mindset with a genuine curiosity about what data reveals and how it can drive action.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

  • Organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple projects at once.

  • Collaborative and commercially aware, able to work effectively with both business and technical teams.


Even better if you have

  • Experience working with retail, FMCG or other operational data environments

  • Exposure to data pipelines, ETL processes or data modelling

  • Hands-on experience using data to drive operational change or performance improvement

  • Familiarity with how data flows from source systems into BI tools

  • A track record of influencing decisions or improving processes through data insights


Is this you?

  • You’re data-driven, curious and thrive in fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments.

  • You enjoy solving messy data problems, working directly with stakeholders and turning analysis into measurable impact.

  • You plan strategically but execute precisely, stay calm under pressure and bring a mix of analytical rigour and creative problem-solving to everything you do.


Inclusion matters

At Quorso, inclusion isn’t just a value, it’s a foundation. We’re committed to building diverse, balanced and open teams where everyone can thrive and contribute. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities.

Position Overview:MHG (Maritime Health Group) is seeking qualified psychologists and psychotherapists to collaborate in providing essential mental health services and 24/7 support to seafarers. The selected candidates will play a vital role in addressing the unique mental health challenges faced by seafarers, including isolation, stress, and the demanding nature of their work environment. This position offers an opportunity to make a significant impact on the well-being of individuals working in the maritime industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Provide Mental Health Services: Offer individual and group counseling sessions to seafarers to address a range of mental health concerns, including but not limited to anxiety, depression, loneliness, and occupational stress.
  2. Offer 24/7 Support: Be available to provide on-call support to seafarers in crisis situations or in need of immediate assistance, ensuring that mental health support is accessible at any time, regardless of location or time zone.
  3. Collaborate with MHG Team: Work closely with other members of the MHG team, including medical professionals, counselors, and maritime experts, to develop comprehensive mental health support programs tailored to the needs of seafarers.

  5. Provide Training and Education: Offer training sessions and workshops to seafarers and maritime companies on mental health awareness, stress management techniques, and strategies for promoting psychological well-being at sea.
  6. Maintain Documentation: Keep accurate and confidential records of counseling sessions, assessments, and interventions in compliance with ethical and legal standards, ensuring the privacy and confidentiality of seafarers' information.

  • A doctoral or master's degree in psychology, counseling, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • At least 5 years of experience as a psychologist or psychotherapist.
  • Licensure or certification as a psychologist or psychotherapist, with relevant experience in providing mental health services.

raw.description:
Olá!

Estamos à procura do futuro Professor(a) de Matemática do Ensino Secundário/Acesso ao Ensino Superior que queira juntar-se a uma equipa que sonha em mudar a forma como as pessoas aprendem.

O setor educativo não consegue evoluir nem aproveitar o poder da tecnologia para maximizar as oportunidades de cada estudante de tirar todo o seu potencial, e é daí que nasce a ideia da Ucademy.

Junta-se a nós?

O nosso objetivo é tornar o caminho dos nossos alunos mais simples, curto e agradável para alcançarem os objetivos que estabeleceram. É simples assim.

Para isso, oferecemos um método de estudo flexível e 100% personalizado através de uma plataforma que aprende com os acertos e erros do aluno para recomendar o caminho a seguir no dia a dia.

Somos 2 engenheiros apaixonados por tecnologia e educação, com vários projetos de empreendedorismo. Há pouco mais de 2 anos, decidimos dar o passo em frente (mais uma vez) e oferecer uma forma diferente de aprender.

Nos nossos primeiros anos:

  • Desenvolvemos uma plataforma totalmente personalizada para que os alunos atinjam os seus objetivos. Este é, claro, o nosso principal objetivo e queremos que você também faça parte dele.

  • Somos uma empresa Great Place to Work (entre as 100 melhores empresas para trabalhar em Espanha em 2023).

  • Ganhámos o prémio de excelência educativa como a melhor academia online de Espanha!

  • Crescemos de 4 para 62 pessoas!

Mas somos muito ambiciosos e não gostamos de nos conformar, por isso, este ano, o desafio é implementar a estratégia de expansão, abrindo escritórios na América Latina e em Portugal, e formar uma comunidade de mais de 12.000 alunos e 1.000 professores.

O que procuramos num Professor(a) de Matemática?

Procuramos alguém com grande vontade de ensinar e de se juntar ao desafio de fazer parte de uma equipa que gosta de assumir riscos, adaptar-se a mudanças e é amante da inovação.

Em poucas palavras, será responsável por ensinar e motivar os nossos alunos do Ensino Secundário no seu novo desafio: a Universidade! Se gosta de explicar, sente-se à vontade com tecnologias e é apaixonado por educação, este é o seu lugar!

A motivação e o compromisso são o nosso motor, por isso procuramos alguém que partilhe essa paixão e entusiasmo pelo que faz. É um deles?

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  1. Criar conteúdo atualizado e de qualidade em formato digital, tanto escrito como gravado, sobre os tópicos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior. Não perdemos o foco no detalhe, por isso consideramos fundamental todas as melhorias que possam ser feitas.

  2. Revisar e atualizar os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior existentes na nossa plataforma. Ser eficiente está no nosso sangue e queremos que você também faça parte disso.

  3. Dar aulas online em direto aos alunos. Tudo o que considerar que pode funcionar para que os alunos sejam mais produtivos e gostem de estudar, será da sua responsabilidade.

  4. Dar apoio aos nossos alunos Ucademy nas suas dúvidas e consultas relacionadas com os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior fornecidos na plataforma, bem como correção de tarefas.

raw.excerpt: Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant?  Don’t worry - you’re not alone.
raw.description:
Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant? Don’t worry - you’re not alone.

Accounting is stuck in the past.

So, we get stuck doing boring, monotonous work as a small cog in tedious firms, or struggling to make an impact in businesses that don’t really care.

RORA was founded to improve the career options for Accountants. We promise impact, variety and progression. We’re looking for those who crave more - more responsibility and more impact - and want to keep progressing and learning with a group of people just like them.

Sound like you? Read on...

The roleWe’re hiring for a FinOps Analyst to be embedded remotely across multiple UK startups and scaleups. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of each partner, taking care of the accountancy fundamentals, whilst also iterating and improving processes through automation and technology.

Here's what the role looks like:

  • Own finance operations: Oversee finance essentials including bookkeeping, (UK) payroll, month-end processes, VAT, and AP/AR, ensuring accuracy and compliance using Xero and other software.

  • Context switching: Balance working across different startups, projects, and changing priorities with accuracy, ensuring partner expectations are managed.

  • Optimise as you go: Identify and drive improvements in finance processes/controls and support with new tech implementations.

  • Build strong connections: Collaborate closely with RORA's FinOps teams across the UK and India, plus your partners, to innovate and solve challenges collaboratively.

Your experience:

  • A minimum of 3 years experience in finance and accounting

  • Confident running finance processes independently (you MUST have strong knowledge across AP, AR and month end as a minimum)

  • Familiar with UK accounting and tax regulations including VAT and payroll etc

  • Experienced in using cloud software such as Xero (strongly preferred)

  • Excellent level of English (verbal and written)

Your setupYou have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in India, whether at home or a co-working space. Your working environment should be quiet and free from distractions, plus strong and reliable internet in a must! Your working day will need to overlap with GMT standard working hours - we ask for at least 4 hours of your day to coincide with UK hours.

It’s probably not for you if…

  • You crave structure and predictability - we believe in moving fast, iterating on the go and figuring things out for ourselves

  • You prefer direction - startups can be unpredictable, we move and adapt with the changes (that’s the fun part!)

  • You require focus on individual tasks - variety is the spice of RORA life, we effortlessly move between competing priorities.

Life at RORAWe’re committed to providing variety, impact and progression, and we do it better than anywhere else.

Benefits

💰 A starting salary of 15 lakhs pa, increasing to 16 lakhs upon successful completion of probation (Mon-Fri)

⏰ Quarterly feedback and bi-annual progression reviews

💰 Annual profit share

⏱ Flexible working

🏝 Fully flexible holiday (34 days to take whenever you like)

🥂 Virtual and in-person team get-togethers

👩‍💻 Co-working space allowance

🚑 Healthcare cover (on passing probation)

💻 One-time tech allowance

🥗 Monthly lunch allowance

🔎 New to startup/scaleup life? Don’t worry - we’ve created a FinOps Training course just for you.

Meet RORARORA builds fractional Finance teams for startups and scaleups, giving you access to some of the most exciting and innovative businesses in the world. We offer the security of being an employee, the variety of contracting, and the support and development opportunities of a big firm.

We promise transparency and fairness

This applies to both our recruitment process and the way we run the company. We're committed to fostering a diverse, healthy and supportive workplace for all. We’re an equal opportunities employer and we genuinely welcome applications from all backgrounds.

Sound good?Please apply! You can expect the application process to take 5 - 10 minutes - we ask for a little effort upfront when applying and in return we promise that we personally review all applications. Your application answers are carefully assessed so please provide honest and reflective answers that are your own (and not AI generated!) Please note: we do not accept reapplications within 12-months.

P.S. If you’re curious to learn more about RORA, our team handbook contains loads of information about life at RORA.

Join CI Games – Players First:

Open Application

Ready to help shape the future of gaming?

At CI Games, we’re not just building games. We’re creating worlds that millions will love. With a bold and aggressive long-term roadmap filled with major releases, we’re entering the most exciting chapter in our history.

We’re actively looking for exceptional talent to join our global team: passionate, driven, and seriously skilled people who live and breathe games.

Don’t see your exact role listed right now? That’s okay.

If you know you bring something special, a unique skill, fresh perspective, or unstoppable drive, we want to hear from you. Great talent doesn’t always fit neatly into a job title, and we refuse to let boxes hold back the right people.

If you’re exceptional, we’ll make room.

Apply now and let’s build the next big thing together.

We value your time

  • Our Talent Acquisition team personally reviews every single CV we receive.

  • We create a level playing field where success is based on merit. Everyone has the same opportunity to grow, thrive, and contribute, free from discrimination or bias.

  • If your background aligns with our studio's needs, either right now or for an upcoming project in our roadmap, we will reach out!

Let's be honest!

On occasions, taking the first step can be challenging.

  • We adapt quickly, embrace change, and learn fast. Because agility allows us to stay ahead in a fast-moving industry, your target role or project priorities could materialize sooner than you think.

  • We value trust and autonomy, and with that comes responsibility. Every team member is accountable for their contribution, their impact, and their results from day one.

  • Because we review every single application individually, it might take our team a little bit of time to get back to you, but we promise you won't be forgotten.

What we offer:

  • Attractive remuneration and annual discretionary bonus.

  • Generous benefits supporting your wellbeing.

  • Opportunities for professional development within a supportive and collaborative team.

  • Remote work with flexible schedules (core working hours 10am-4pm CET), allowing you to work alongside talented individuals from around the world.

  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and stay at the forefront of the gaming industry.

  • A diverse and inclusive workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or social status.

  • Company events and wrap-up parties, access to all games released by CI Games and company merchandise.

  • A chance to be part of something ground-breaking as we shape the future of gaming.

Compensation & Pay Transparency

One of CI Games’ Core Values is Equality of Opportunity and we are therefore committed to fair and transparent hiring. Since we hire remote talent across multiple regions, compensation packages are country specific. If your application is shortlisted, we will share the specific salary range for your location with your interview invite, ensuring you have the information you need before we begin formal conversations.

We are an equal opportunities employer, hiring and developing our best talent based on merit. Accessibility is at the heart of our games, and we are committed to not discriminating against people based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or social status. Should you require adjustments or flexible arrangements to interview, or take up a role with us, please let us know in your application and we will accommodate to the best of our ability.

Maak jij écht contact met mensen, of het nu opdrachtgevers, volgers of collega's zijn? Wil je anderen helpen met jouw kennis en ervaring? Werk je graag flexibel vanuit huis? Dan is werken bij ons iets voor jou!

Over Webmastery

Webmastery is een groeiende social enterprise die webcare en contentcreatie verzorgt voor goede doelen en andere kennisintensieve organisaties die zich inzetten voor een mooiere samenleving. Denk aan Alzheimer Nederland, VluchtelingenWerk en Kinderpostzegels.

Onze missie: het keurslijf van de traditionele kantoorbaan loslaten, zodat meer mensen met een aandoening een zinvolle en uitdagende baan kunnen vinden. We geloven in flexibel werken en benutten ieders talent op een manier die energie geeft.

Flexibel en inclusief werken

Bij Webmastery werk je:

  • Vanuit huis – of een andere plek die voor jou prettig werkt.

  • Op tijden die bij jou passen – zodat je werkt wanneer je energie hebt.

  • In een ondersteunend team – waarin we elkaar helpen en aanvullen.

  • Met impact – door direct bij te dragen aan ons als social enterprise en aan de goede doelen en impactorganisaties die onze opdrachtgevers zijn.

Wat ga je doen?

Wij geloven niet in vaste functieprofielen, maar bewegen mee met jouw talent en hetgeen waar jij energie van krijgt. Daarom kun je je eigen takenpakket samenstellen.

We zijn vaak op zoek naar mensen voor de volgende taken:

Webcare in de avond

Je zorgt dat volgers van goede doelen zich gehoord en geholpen voelen. Dit doe je door reacties op social media en andere kanalen op een vriendelijke en professionele manier af te handelen. Je leert de tone of voice van onze opdrachtgevers en helpt volgers met jouw inlevingsvermogen en kennis.

🕣 2 tot 4 uur per avond op 2 tot 5 avonden per week.
👩‍🎓 In de avond zijn er minder collega's om te helpen. Daarom zoeken we een ervaren communicatiespecialist of klantenservicemedewerker.
💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: medewerker klantenservice.

Webcare rondom het weekend

Je zorgt dat volgers van goede doelen zich gehoord en geholpen voelen. Dit doe je door reacties op social media en andere kanalen op een vriendelijke en professionele manier af te handelen. Je leert de tone of voice van onze opdrachtgevers en helpt volgers met jouw inlevingsvermogen en kennis.

🕣 3 of 6 uur per dag op 2 tot 5 dagen in de week rondom het weekend (donderdag tot maandag).

👩‍🎓 Je hebt hbo-denk- en werkniveau.

💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: medewerker klantenservice.

Webcare buiten eigen socials

Je speurt het internet af naar gesprekken over maatschappelijke thema’s van onze opdrachtgevers en zorgt dat de goede doelen zichtbaar aanwezig zijn in die gesprekken. Met jouw scherpe blik, vriendelijke toon en strategisch gevoel reageer je op posts waar onze opdrachtgevers niet getagd zijn, maar wél willen meepraten. Je herkent kansen om te verbinden, misverstanden recht te zetten en verhalen op te halen die raken. Zo help je volgers én versterk je de boodschap van de organisatie.

🕣 1 tot 4 uur per dag op 2 tot 5 dagen per week, bij voorkeur ook een weekenddag.
👩‍🎓 Je hebt een opleiding communicatie of werkervaring dat laat zien dat je communicatieboodschappen kan verwerken tot reacties.
💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: webjournalist.

Belangenbehartiging & storytelling

Je brengt in kaart welke stakeholders, ervaringsdeskundigen en influencers actief zijn binnen de thema’s van onze opdrachtgevers. Via socials, e-mail en (beeld)bellen onderhoud je contact met hen en bouw je aan duurzame, wederkerige samenwerkingen.

Samen zorg je ervoor dat maatschappelijke thema’s online meer aandacht krijgen en dat de belangen en standpunten van onze opdrachtgevers goed vertegenwoordigd worden. Je weet hoe je online gesprekken op gang brengt, mensen verbindt en samenwerkt aan meer begrip, zichtbaarheid en impact rondom maatschappelijke onderwerpen.

Je interviewt partners en ervaringsdeskundigen en vertaalt hun verhalen naar verhalende content voor de socials van zowel onze opdrachtgevers als de samenwerkingspartners.

Met jouw scherpe blik, vriendelijke toon en strategisch gevoel verdiep je je snel in verschillende goede doelen en kun je hun stem online goed vertegenwoordigen. Je begrijpt welke verhalen mensen raken en hoe online communities bijdragen aan maatschappelijke verandering. Zo maak je impact.

🕣 1 tot 5 uur per dag op 4 tot 5 dagen per week.
👩‍🎓 Je hebt een communicatieopleiding of relevante werkervaring waaruit blijkt dat je communicatieboodschappen kunt vertalen naar sterke online gesprekken en content.
💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: web-journalist.

Contentcreatie

Je maakt berichten waarvoor mensen stoppen met scrollen. Van het schrijven van pakkende teksten op basis van storytelling tot het maken van shortform-video.

🕣 12 uur of meer per week, verdeeld over minimaal 4 dagen.
👩‍🎓 Je hebt hbo-denk en werkniveau. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in communicatie gevolgd en/of meerdere jaren ervaring als social media redacteur of contentcreator.
💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: webjournalist.

Extra taak: analyses maken

Je maakt socialmediarapportages voor onze opdrachtgevers. Je analyseert interactie en bereik en adviseert wat opdrachtgevers kunnen doen om hun achterban te vergroten.

🕣 4 tot 8 uur per week.

👩‍🎓 Je hebt hbo-denk en werkniveau. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in communicatie gevolgd en/of meerdere jaren ervaring als social media redacteur of contentcreator.
💲 Salaris marktconform, zie loonwijzer.nl functie: webjournalist.

Extra taak: grafische ontwerp

We hebben niet voldoende werk voor een dedicated grafisch ontwerper, maar je kunt het werk wel als extra taak oppakken. Je maakt op verzoek infographics voor onze opdrachtgevers. En je voert de nieuwe huisstijl door in onze uitingen, zoals rapportages en offertes.

🕣 Ongeveer 4 uur per week.

Extra taak: correctieronde op zondag en maandag

Elke dag om 16:00 uur kijkt een collega na of alles goed staat ingepland en er geen foutjes ingeslopen zijn. Op dit moment werken onze beide correctors niet op zondag en maandag. Vind je het leuk om deze ronde mee te pakken? Laat het weten.

🕣 Ongeveer 1 uur per week.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt sterke schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden in het Nederlands.

  • Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende opdrachtgevers en communicatiestijlen.

  • Je past in ons team van enthousiaste, betrokken en flexibele collega’s.

Jouw achtergrond

  • We nemen graag geschikte kandidaten aan die door een aandoening niet passen in een traditionele kantoorbaan (zoals professionals uit de Wajong, WIA, WAO of doelgroepregister). Het is geen probleem dat je maar één van de taken kiest die hierboven staan en nog niet voldoet aan alle eisen. Mensen met talent kunnen het leren on the job.

  • NB: We staan soms ook open voor professionals (zonder aandoening) die meerdere taken willen combineren in een groter deeltijd of fulltime dienstverband. We zoeken dan een ervaren persoon die stevig staat en een vangnet kan zijn voor collega's die dat soms nodig hebben. Dat is op dit moment niet zo.

  • Ervaring met inclusieve communicatie of een diverse achtergrond is een pre: we waarderen kennis van verschillende culturen en talen die in Nederland voorkomen. Maar denk hierbij ook aan ervaring in LHBTQI+-gemeenschap.

  • Je woont (voornamelijk) in Nederland of Spanje.

Wat bieden we?

  • Een mensgericht arbeidscontract:opgesteld op basis van conscious contracting. Zonder juridische teksten en op basis van gelijkheid. Zo beloven we bijvoorbeeld dat bijeenkomsten op locatie nooit verplicht zijn.
    (NB: het is niet mogelijk om als zzp'er te starten).

  • Dagen en uren in overleg: Je werkt minimaal 12 uur per week. Voor mensen die door een aandoening een plek zoeken om werkfit te worden, is starten met minder geen probleem.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen (inclusief de feestdagen die je zelf kunt bepalen) en een onbeperkt aantal roostervrije dagen.

  • 120 euro onkostenvergoeding per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een warm en betrokken team waar nieuwe medewerkers zich snel thuis voelen.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen webcare, contentcreatie en projectmanagement. Functies blijven bij ons flexibel.

Interesse?

We zijn op dit moment op sterkte. Er is geen actieve sollicitatieprocedure. Maar je mag altijd alvast laten weten dat je interesse hebt om bij ons te komen werken. Laat weten welke taken je aanspreken via dit formulier. 👇 We zijn benieuwd naar je motivatie en cv!

raw.description:
Lieu de travail : France, à distance

Date de début : Dès que possible

DataForce by TransPerfectpropose des opportunités à l’échelle mondiale pour travailler sur des projets liés à l’annotation de données, à la transcription et à des études rémunérées, contribuant ainsi à améliorer et à faire progresser les technologies modernes.

Actuellement, nous recherchons des personnes de langue maternelle française (France) présentant divers accents régionaux dans le cadre d’une étude visant à améliorer les technologies d’assistants vocaux.

Il s’agit d’une étude entièrement à distance. Vous pouvez participer depuis n’importe où en France.

Description de la tâche :

Les participants enregistreront de courtes phrases d’activation et des énoncés scénarisés généralement utilisés lors d’interactions avec un assistant vocal.

Qui peut participer à l’étude ?

Pour participer, vous devez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • Avoir 18 ansou plus.
  • Être né(e) et vivre en France.
  • Être de langue maternelle française (France), de n’importe quelle région de France.
  • Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais car toutes les instructions du projet seront en anglais.
  • Être en mesure d’utiliser un téléphone portable pour ce projet.
  • Pouvoir utiliser un casque filaire ou le microphone de l’appareil pour enregistrer des phrases.
  • Avoir accès à un environnement intérieur calme pour effectuer les enregistrements.

Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous recherchons des participants issus de groupes démographiques spécifiques afin de contribuer au développement d’une technologie impartiale qui soit représentative de tous.

Durée de la tâche :

La durée estimée de la tâche d’enregistrement est de 30 minutes.

Rémunération :

Vous recevrez 33 $ USDpour vos livrables entièrement terminés et acceptés.

Programme général de prime de parrainage

Nous offrons une prime de parrainage de 15 $ USD pour chaque participant que vous recommandez pour l’étude et qui la termine avec succès.

Comment parrainer quelqu’un :

  • Partagez ce lien d’inscription avec vos amis et votre famille
  • Lors de l’inscription, ils doivent répondre « Referral / Recommandation » à la question « Comment avez-vous entendu parler de cette opportunité ? » et indiquer votre nom et votre adresse e-mail dans les champs : Prénom, Nom et adresse e-mail.

Comme mode de paiement, nous proposons le Virement bancaire, PayPalet la Carte cadeau, selon votre préférence.

Veuillez noter que notre équipe d’assurance qualité examinera toutes les soumissions pour s’assurer qu’elles respectent les exigences spécifiques du projet. L’équipe du projet vous enverra des commentaires une fois le processus de contrôle qualité terminé.

Des questions ou des doutes ?

Si vous avez des doutes ou des questions, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à :

DataForce by TransPerfect fait partie de la famille d’entreprises TransPerfect, le plus grand fournisseur mondial de solutions linguistiques et technologiques pour les entreprises internationales, avec des bureaux dans plus de 100 villes à travers le monde. Nous proposons des données de haute qualité pour l’interaction homme-machine à certaines des entreprises technologiques les plus prestigieuses au monde. Notre département se concentre sur la collecte, l’enrichissement et le traitement des données pour l’apprentissage automatique dans différents domaines de l’IA.
